programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 864
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.desc: 《乡野有真味第三季》将镜头投向中国南方的隐秘角落——广东、广西、浙江、福建、湖南、江西、安徽、贵州八省，深入竹林溪涧、古村深巷，探访那些颠覆味蕾认知的“暗黑”美食与新奇风味，揭开乡土食材与地域文化交织的味觉密码。“Country Roads Delicious Food S3” turns to the hidden corners of southern China, the eight provinces of Guangdong, Guangxi, Zhejiang, Fujian, Hunan, Jiangxi, Anhui and Guizhou. programme.title: 两岸一味第一季&第二季 / The Flavourful Link Across the Strait S1 & S2 Episode 6
programme.desc: 以街头巷尾的民间味道为联结，追溯两岸美食的中华渊源，讲述两岸故事，共鸣情感与文化。六大主题版块，30种两岸吃食，60组人文故事，用两岸一脉共生的食之味，展现两岸一根同源的人情味，讲述两岸饮食的人间烟火，追寻中华民族的味觉乡愁。

programme.desc: 该剧为一部浪漫复仇剧，讲述了梦想成为现代版巨商林尚玉的女子龙秀晶与将命运托付给她的吝啬鬼绝症患者吕义柱相遇后，两人共同展开复仇的故事。剧中还涉及与财阀家族相关的出生秘密等人物关系。Yong Su-Jeong is a popular but shy-in-love host who has a crush on a rich heir, Joo Woo-Jin, while hardworking Yeo Ui-Joo’s life changes when he discovers he’s also part of the same wealthy family.

programme.title: 下饭江湖第三季 / The Soul of a Meal S3 Episode 5
programme.desc: 《下饭江湖 第三季》通过食物讲述与之间紧密相连的人的故事，这群普通人活出了价值、尊严、自信，让观众从中获得些许勇气，同时有一种共鸣，就是每一个人都要为之奋斗的精神。希望通过节目把这种平凡人的奋斗精神、以及人间值得的烟火气传递给更多还在寻找生活真谛的人们。

programme.title: 亦舞之城 / Second Chance Romance Episode 3

programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 865
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 绝佳的解决士 / Queen of Divorce Episode 11
programme.desc: 金莎拉是一位成功的律师，却在经历丈夫的背叛以及连串绯闻后，在一夜之间失去了家庭和事业。这使她悲痛欲绝，并决定报复。她伙拍曾是实力过人、但后来突然卸任的前检察官董基俊，一同创立离婚解决企业「Solution」，专惩罚不忠的配偶，为冤枉者提供量身定做的解决方案。

programme.title: 他从火光中走来 / Bright Eyes in the Dark Episode 10
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长。因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官。在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初。南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近。年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九、秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队。老中青三代消防员们在火灾、地震、空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶。南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进。

A mortal man accidentally time-travels to the past and becomes the Monkey King. Unwilling to accept his fate, he embarks on a journey that brings him to face gods and demons.

programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长。因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官。在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初。南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近。年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九、秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队。老中青三代消防员们在火灾、地震、空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶。南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进。

programme.desc: 《藏海传》以大雍国钦天监监正一门遭灭亡为开端，讲述了唯一幸存的儿子稚奴获救后，改名换姓为藏海，潜心研习营造技艺和谋略之术，最终返回朝野，寻找真相、手刃仇人、坚守正义的故事。In the Great Yong Dynasty, esteemed Imperial Astronomer Kuai Duo and his family suffer a tragic downfall, leaving his young son, Zhinu, as the sole survivor. Rescued and given a new identity as Zang Hai, he dedicates himself to mastering architectural craftsmanship and strategic diplomacy. Years later, Zang Hai returns to the imperial court, determined to uncover the truth, avenge his family, and uphold just...

programme.title: 嗨放派 3 / Have Fun Season 3 Episode 7
programme.desc: 《嗨放派》是一档奇趣实验类真人秀综艺节目，第三季主打真实的生存实验，六位艺人嘉宾将开启十天荒岛生存挑战，比如需要自食其力体验搭建帐篷、自制淋浴间、起火烧饭、自制做饭器具等挑战，最后还要举行一场别开生面的海岛运动会，用最好玩的方式将科学实践到生活里头。 “Have Fun” returns for a third season! The very well-received China variety again sees six popular male artistes teaming up to escape the constraints and pressures of city life and having fun through exploring interesting scientific topics and real-life Science experiments, this time on a remote island looking for survival!

programme.title: 勇敢无双龙秀晶 / The Brave Yong Su Jeong Episode 82
programme.desc: 该剧为一部浪漫复仇剧，讲述了梦想成为现代版巨商林尚玉的女子龙秀晶与将命运托付给她的吝啬鬼绝症患者吕义柱相遇后，两人共同展开复仇的故事。剧中还涉及与财阀家族相关的出生秘密等人物关系。Yong Su-Jeong is a popular but shy-in-love host who has a crush on a rich heir, Joo Woo-Jin, while hardworking Yeo Ui-Joo’s life changes when he discovers he’s also part of the same wealthy family.

programme.desc: This episode features Themba 'The Answer' Gorimbo and Luke 'Young Gun' Michael battling for the vacant welterweight championship. Vicious ground and pound ends this fight before the end of Round 1. Bonus coverage includes Sizwe Mnikathi vs. August Kayambala.

programme.title: MEGA Fights Episode 49
programme.desc: MEGA Fights are premiere events from the sport of boxing including HBO World Championship Boxing and historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. This episode features undefeated featherweights Yuriorkis Gamboa, 'El Cinclon de Guantanamo', (11-0, 9 KOs) and Marcos Ramirez (25-0, 16 KOs) from the Pechanga Resort and Casino in Temecula, California, USA, on October 4, 2008. The two young fighters had a quick ending street brawl that brought the crowd to its feet.

programme.title: World Karate Federation Episode 5
programme.desc: The highest level of competition in the sport of karate anywhere in the world will take place from Budapest, Hungary, as the WKF SENIOR WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS take place. The top competitors from across the globe, from six different continents, will all converge on Budapest to stake their claim as the best in the world. Don't miss the WKF SENIOR WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS, only on FIGHT SPORTS.

programme.title: BWF Martial Arts Episode 2
programme.desc: This episode features highlights from the Men's Forms Championships as well as Girl's Weapons, Synchronized Team Forms and Boy's and Girl's Traditional Weapons.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! Episode 26
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is a light welterweight title unification bout between Amir Khan and Danny Garcia. Also on the card, former heavyweight champ James Kirkland.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo Episode 5
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Episode 5, from Ryogoku Kokugikan in Tokyo, Japan, features Asanoyama, Daieisho, Terunofuji and Shodai.

programme.title: Judo for the World Episode 6
programme.desc: Judo for the World features the best competitors in the sport as they compete in a global tour for an opportunity to vie for the gold in the World Judo Championship. In this episode we see the best of the Judo Grand Slam from Ekaterinburg, speak with number 1 ranked fighter Khasan Khalmurzaev about his return to Judo, and show Soichi Hashimoto's success using his signature throw.

programme.title: Prison Fighters Episode 2
programme.desc: This series follows former Muay Thai champion Noy Khaopan and American Cody Moberly, two inmates in a Thailand prison, who after seven years are given the chance to fight for their release. By joining a controversial government modern day Prison Fight program, murderers and felons are given the chance to fight for their freedom, and possible redemption, through the ancient tradition of Muay Thai matches. Episode 2 of 4.

programme.desc: Celebrate as Paul scraps the cramped layout in Brian and Alison's kitchen in favour of a massive central island, a pizza oven, and an easy-breezy Cape Cod feel. Then check out Tina's multi-functional art station, which is ready for rave reviews.

programme.title: PL STORIES Episode 7
programme.desc: We take a trip down memory lane to revisit the incredible story of Norwich City's unforgettable 1992-93 season; the campaign that saw an unfancied side come within touching distance of becoming the first-ever Premier League champions. Through interviews with the players and staff who lived it, we relive the pressure, drama and defining moments of a nerve-shredding title battle with Manchester United that could have changed English football history forever.

programme.title: PL STORIES Episode 6
programme.desc: We spend the day with Dean Ashton as he reflects on a career that promised so much and was cut short far too soon. From his rise through the Football League to becoming one of the Premier League's most exciting forwards with West Ham United, Ashton looks back on the goals, injuries and moments that shaped his journey in the game. Now working as a respected pundit, we see how his passion and understanding of football continue to drive him long after retirement.

programme.title: Liverpool vs Bournemouth (MW01)
programme.desc: Liverpool are unbeaten on the opening day in the last 12 PL seasons (W9, D3) - the longest ongoing run in PL.

programme.title: Chelsea vs Brighton and Hove Albion (MW06) Episode 52
programme.desc: In all competitions, Chelsea have won nine and lost just one of their 12 previous home games against Brighton and Hove Albion (D2), winning their last three in a row since a 1-2 reverse in April 2023.

programme.title: Newcastle United vs Liverpool (MW02) Episode 20
programme.desc: Newcastle haven't scored in any of their last four Premier League matches without Alexander Isak featuring (D2 L2), having 47 shots and accumulating an xG of 5.57 without scoring in these games.

programme.title: West Ham United vs Aston Villa (MW16) Episode 158
programme.desc: West Ham are winless in their last five Premier League games against Aston Villa (D3 L2), having won five in a row against them before that.

programme.title: Newcastle United vs Arsenal (MW06) Episode 59
programme.desc: Newcastle have kept four clean sheets in their five Premier League games this season, conceding only in their 3-2 defeat to Liverpool. However, the Magpies have also failed to score in three of their five league games so far.

programme.title: Chelsea vs Liverpool (MW07) Episode 65
programme.desc: After their 3-1 win in May, Chelsea could enjoy back-to-back league wins over Liverpool for the first time since November 2014 (3 in a row).

programme.title: Manchester United vs Fulham (MW24) Episode 237
programme.desc: Manchester United have lost just one of their last 20 Premier League games against Fulham (W15 D4), going down 2-1 at Old Trafford in February 2024.

programme.title: Newcastle United vs Leeds United (MW21) Episode 209
programme.desc: Newcastle have won just one of their last seven Premier League games against Leeds (D4 L2), beating them 1-0 at Elland Road in January 2022.

programme.title: Aston Villa vs Brighton and Hove Albion (MW26) Episode 255
programme.desc: Aston Villa won reverse fixture 4-3 at Brighton after coming from 2-0 down, Dec 3 – looking for a third PL double over Brighton

programme.title: Crystal Palace vs Liverpool (MW06) Episode 53
programme.desc: Crystal Palace have won just one of their last 16 Premier League meetings with Liverpool (D3 L12), winning 1-0 at Anfield in April 2024. The Eagles haven't scored more than once in any of their last 12 league games against the Reds (6 goals).

programme.title: Manchester City vs Chelsea (MW20) Episode 200
programme.desc: Man City are unbeaten in their last eight Premier League games against Chelsea (W6 D2), their joint-longest run without defeat against the Blues in their league history (also 8 between 1936 and 1949).

programme.title: Bournemouth vs Liverpool (MW23) Episode 225
programme.desc: Liverpool are unbeaten in their last 10 Premier League games, the longest current run of any side (W4 D6). However, they've drawn each of their last four, last drawing more consecutive league games in October/November 1980 (5).

programme.title: Chelsea vs Sunderland (MW09) Episode 82
programme.desc: Having won four of their first six Premier League games against Chelsea between 1996 and 2001 (L2), Sunderland have since won just three of their 26 against the Blues (D2 L21).

programme.title: Wolverhampton Wanderers vs Liverpool (MW29) Episode 284
programme.desc: Wolves have lost 17 of their last 18 Premier League matches against Liverpool, winning the other 3-0 in February 2023 at Molineux under Julen Lopetegui.

programme.title: West Ham United vs Everton (MW34) Episode 337
programme.desc: Everton have won more Premier League games against West Ham both overall (29) and away from home (13) than they have vs any other opponent in the competition.

programme.title: Newcastle United vs Bournemouth (MW33) Episode 323
programme.desc: Newcastle are winless in their last seven Premier League games against Bournemouth, with five of those finishing level (L2).

programme.title: Everton vs Liverpool (MW33) Episode 327
programme.desc: Everton have won just one of their last 14 Premier League home games against Liverpool, though 10 of those games have finished level (L3).

programme.title: Chelsea vs West Ham United (MW24) Episode 234
programme.desc: West Ham have won just one of their last 19 Premier League away games against Chelsea (D4 L14), losing the last five in a row since a 1-0 victory in November 2019.

programme.desc: Japanese garlic is big, with sweetness and umami. In Aomori, we explore what makes it special, take a closer look at black garlic, and sample all kinds of dishes that show off garlic's potential.

programme.title: Rafael Nadal: King Of Clay
programme.desc: This documentary delves into the life of tennis legend Rafael Nadal, exploring his journey from a young prodigy to a global icon. Through triumphs and challenges, it reveals the dedication that defines Nadal's legacy on and off the court.

programme.title: Lady Gaga: Dance Or Die
programme.desc: From underground clubs to global superstardom, Lady Gaga: Dance or Die explores the unstoppable rise of the pop icon who redefined music, fashion, and fame. Through triumphs and tribulations, witness how Gaga danced through life's challenges — and won.

programme.title: Air Warriors S11
programme.desc: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air artillery since then.

programme.title: Air Warriors S11 Episode 2
programme.desc: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air artillery since then.

programme.title: Gerrard: Born To Lead
programme.desc: In an illustrious professional career that spans over 20 years, Gerrard has experienced and succeeded at the pinnacle of the sport, lifting trophies as a player and manager, and representing his country. But with the highs, came the lows.

programme.title: Neymar: Brazil's Number One
programme.desc: From the streets of Santos to becoming Brazil's number one goal scorer, the 20-year journey of Neymar is one for the history books. Having played football on nearly every continent, Neymar will go down as a legend of the game, forever.

programme.title: Cristiano Ronaldo: The One And Only
programme.desc: Witness the journey from the young Portuguese prodigy to one of the greatest players of all time. This is the one and only...Cristiano Ronaldo.

programme.title: Messi: The Chosen One
programme.desc: This documentary offers an intimate and comprehensive journey through the extraordinary career of Lionel Messi — from his humble beginnings in Rosario, Argentina, to becoming a global football icon.

programme.title: Kylian Mbappé: Rising Star
programme.desc: There are few players who capture the imagination of fans worldwide quite like Kylian Mbappé. In just over a decade, he went from absolute obscurity to becoming one of the most famous players in the world.

programme.title: Andy Murray: Game, Set, Match
programme.desc: From a small-town prodigy to World No. 1, Andy Murray: Game Set Match chronicles his relentless pursuit of greatness, his battles with injury, and his enduring legacy as one of tennis's most inspiring figures.

programme.title: Messi: The Chosen One
programme.desc: This documentary offers an intimate and comprehensive journey through the extraordinary career of Lionel Messi — from his humble beginnings in Rosario, Argentina, to becoming a global football icon.

programme.title: Kylian Mbappé: Rising Star
programme.desc: There are few players who capture the imagination of fans worldwide quite like Kylian Mbappé. In just over a decade, he went from absolute obscurity to becoming one of the most famous players in the world.

programme.title: Wildest Survival Episode 10
programme.desc: In this episode we explore why and how animals fight and reveal the ways in which they are programmed to survive at all costs.

programme.title: Wild Heroes
programme.desc: Auckland Zoo's primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

programme.title: Wild Heroes Episode 2
programme.desc: Auckland Zoo's vet team commences critical care to save the life of an endangered sea turtle snared on a fishing line, and after 3 years without tigers at the Zoo, the team stand by to welcome a new big cat.

programme.title: Wild Heroes Episode 3
programme.desc: We follow Auckland Zoo's bird team into the wilds of the Coromandel Ranges as they help to save native kiwi populations, It's a feeding frenzy for the Tasmanian devils and the elephant team faces their biggest challenge yet.

programme.title: Wild Heroes Episode 4
programme.desc: This time on Wild Heroes, there's shocking news for the elephant team, the vets are concerned about one of their rescued Little penguins, and we find out how it really does take a community to feed the Zoo.

programme.title: Food Trail: South Africa
programme.desc: Warren's first stop on his food trail of South Africa is the bustling city of Cape Town. Here, he visits a lively farmers market and cooks up a Cape Malay Curry in Bo Kaap.

programme.title: Food Trail: South Africa Episode 2
programme.desc: Warren continues his food trail along South Africa's Cape Coast, stopping off at the township of Khayelitsha, home to some inspiring micro-farming initiatives, before arriving at Grootbos Private Nature Reserve.

programme.title: Food Trail: South Africa Episode 3
programme.desc: Warren heads to the Cape Winelands, where he tastes a variety of local wines including Pinotage, a signature South African red, and Ratafia, a unique and complex fortified wine.

programme.title: Food Trail: South Africa Episode 4
programme.desc: Warren's next stop on his food trail is Tswalu Nature Reserve, in the heart of the Kalahari Desert. Warren then meets with acclaimed Chef Marnus to cook up some exciting South African delicacies.

programme.title: Food Trail: South Africa Episode 5
programme.desc: Warren heads to the coastal city of Durban - where he's staying at the iconic Oyster Box hotel.

programme.title: Food Trail: South Africa Episode 6
programme.desc: In Durban, Warren visits the famous restaurant Max's Lifestyle for an indulgent Shisa Nyama experience, before meeting with local guide Thoko to visit a nearby Zulu village.

programme.title: The Real Mad Men Of Advertising Episode 4
programme.desc: See how advertisers used a new optimism and new technology to sell big in the "Greed is Good" era.

programme.title: Gameplay: The Story Of The Videogame Revolution
programme.desc: Gameplay is a feature on the history of videogames. From Pong to Pac Man, Super Mario to Lara Croft, Doom, Grand Theft Auto and beyond, we chronicle the remarkable story of the fastest evolving new media of all time.

programme.title: Food Trail: South Africa S2 Episode 7
programme.desc: Warren is in the Franschhoek Valley, exploring the endless bounty of Boschendal Wine Estate.

programme.title: Food Trail: South Africa S2 Episode 8
programme.desc: Continuing to listen to his heart, Warren deepens his love of wine by venturing to the lesser known town of Hermanus, where he'll visit Newton Johnson, the ‘wine farm with a view'.

programme.title: Food Trail: South Africa S2 Episode 9
programme.desc: Warren is heading out of Cape Town into the more quiet coastal area of the Western Cape, and the picturesque town of Paternoster. It's here he'll marvel at the seaside village feel and take an e-bike ride along the beach.

programme.title: Food Trail: South Africa S2 Episode 10
programme.desc: As the final stanza in Warren's Food Trail of South Africa, he's back in the bush, a quintessential part of all travel to the rainbow nation.

programme.title: Food Trail: South Africa S2
programme.desc: Warren commences his second Food Trail of South Africa in the world famous Kruger National Park and surrounds.

programme.title: Food Trail: South Africa S2 Episode 2
programme.desc: Johannesburg - the gateway city to exploring South Africa! In this episode Warren indulges in the vibrant international flavours and surrounds of the Sandton neighbourhood, loved by locals and visitors alike.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: Singapore
programme.desc: Adam Liaw catches up with a cousin from his father's side of the family to learn how he has been making Hainanese chicken rice for over 30 years.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: Singapore Episode 2
programme.desc: Adam learns to make authentic beef rendang from a local Muslim family. He visits the National Archives of Singapore to learn about his mother's family, and continues his search for inspiration for his Singapore banquet dinner.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: Singapore Episode 3
programme.desc: Adam visits Peranakan food legend Violet Oon's restaurant, National Kitchen. He then heads to Chinatown to visit Aussie Dave Pynt's restaurant, Burnt Ends.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: Singapore Episode 4
programme.desc: Adam goes in search of the best seafood that Singapore has to offer. His journey begins inside the Marina Bay Sands resort complex where many celebrity chefs have opened eateries.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: Singapore Episode 5
programme.desc: Adam Liaw continues his search for seafood inspiration by heading to the famous Newton Food Centre. He gives a masterclass on how to line up a seafood feast like no other.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: Singapore Episode 6
programme.desc: Adam Liaw goes in search of Singapore's best vegetable dishes, kicking off with a traditional breakfast at Singapore Zoo, including kaya toast with half-cooked eggs and coffee.

programme.title: Lady Gaga: Dance Or Die

programme.title: Mariah Carey: Grit And Glamour
programme.desc: A Cinderella story of sorts, Mariah Carey. Songbird Supreme. Queen of Christmas. Dedicated philanthropist. Mariah has sold over 220 million records and released the best-selling Christmas album ever.

programme.title: Robin Williams: Laugh Until You Cry
programme.desc: The comic genius with an electric mind, with a range of talent that left us breathless. His story inspires us to look past the mask of those people who seem to have a perfect life. His legacy lives on.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: Look behind the scenes and meet the innovative teams working to preserve and protect Kenya's wildlife. Check out Save the Elephants' radio-tracking-collar system, a drone that monitors wild dog packs, and a local team of Maasai cheetah trackers.

programme.title: Weird, Wild & Wonderful
programme.desc: Trek across Africa for a peek at the colorful, quirky survival strategies of its animals. See these furry, feathered, and scaled magicians, from flamboyant flamingos to vanishing lizards, find food, elude predators, and find mates against all odds.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School Season 2 Episode 2
programme.desc: Crash a fruit-flinging party celebrating the return of Jelapat, Talaken, Bawan, and Rona to the nursery to join the rest of their classmates. Meanwhile, flooding overtakes the pre-release islands, and injuries stifle the progress of two students.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Season 3 Episode 3
programme.desc: Head into surgery with Mara the koala, who needs a life-saving tooth operation, then assess an injured sugar glider with vet Tim. Cheer as rescue officer Elise pulls a flying fox out of a gutter and see nurse Bree's clutch of python eggs hatch.

programme.title: Ireland's Wild Islands with Eoin Warner Season 1
programme.desc: Begin on Rathlin, where flightless guillemot chicks take a leap of faith and golden hares welcome the dawn. Head to Tory to see basking sharks, dolphins, and the endangered corncrake's dance of love. Then chase adorable Irish stoats across Achill.

programme.title: Life's Journey Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: For every species on earth the right to mate is the purpose of life. Passing on your genes to the next generation is every animal's legacy. But it's not easy, it can be a struggle to find a mate and then a fight to gain access. Only the strongest and most determined will win at Luangwa's mating game.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Season 3 Episode 4
programme.desc: Stand by as rescue officers use a technique called flagging to nab a koala with dangerously inflamed eyes. Soothe burned possum feet with vet Tim, then shadow vet Karina as she examines a half-drowned platypus before referring him to a specialist.

programme.title: Boss Shark: Battle of the Sexes
programme.desc: Witness a shark competition unlike any other, where great whites go head-to-head in jaw-dropping tests of strength. Risk it all with shark specialist Dr. Riley Elliott as he tries to answer an age-old question: Which sex reigns supreme?

programme.title: City Wildlife Rescue Season 1 Episode 11
programme.desc: Join the rescue team for a madcap chase after a red-tailed hawk. He may be unable to fly, but he sure can run! Then follow the recovery of a rare albino squirrel who can't walk, and see how the medical team ensures he'll be ready for the wild again.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Koala Season 1
programme.desc: Despite being one of Australia's best-known marsupials, koalas live only in the east and southeast parts of the continent. Learn how their lives and behaviors vary in these different regions.

programme.title: Animal Empires Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: There's strength in numbers. Especially in the wild. For many species, it's the very reason why individuals come together. Protecting the empire is imperative to survival. For these animals, protection means isolation – finding sanctuary from the threats outside their boundaries.

programme.title: Land of Primates Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: The gelada is a rare monkey that lives in the Simien Mountains of Ethiopia. They're charismatic, vocal, and mix affection and confrontation. Watch as they face the challenges of their habitat—and each other.

programme.title: Land of Primates Season 1 Episode 6
programme.desc: Enter the wilds of South Africa to get an intimate look into one of the continent's most misunderstood primates. Like humans, these primates have unique personalities and share strong bonds with their families and friends.

programme.title: Land of Primates Season 1 Episode 7
programme.desc: As humans take up more space, the baboons of Africa must adapt. Travel across the continent to watch them form unbreakable social bonds, serve to protect their families and survive a changing landscape.

programme.title: Land of Primates Season 1 Episode 8
programme.desc: Off the coast of Tanzania, baby Kima lives with his family of red Colobus monkeys. But what happens when he loses his way? Discover how this little monkey learns to adapt to life in the jungle—and find out if he can reconnect with his family again.

programme.title: Wild Survivors Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: From weaver birds that create intricate nests with strands of grass to swarms of tiny termites that build towers ten feet high, see how Luangwa Valley's diverse array of animals sculpt their complex ecosystem.

programme.title: Uptown Otters Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Get ready to rumble in Marina Bay, where the Nomads and Townies are squatting while Anna and the Bay Family are away upriver. Soak up the peaceful otter life in this luxurious waterway before the surprise early return of its rightful owners.

programme.title: Uptown Otters Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: Welcome Anna's clan back to Marina Bay, where two otter families have been trespassing. Feel the heat when Mia catches Anna's scent and hustles the Townies out of reach. Then hold tight as the Nomads remain blissfully unaware of the coming conflict.

programme.title: Uptown Otters Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: Follow the Bay Family's matriarch as she chases the Nomads out of her territory for good, and examine the surprising birthing den where the Townies' leader, Mia, settles in. Then kick back with the Mangrove Family as they pal around with stray dogs.

programme.title: Uptown Otters Season 1 Episode 6
programme.desc: Chase Anna to the Townies' lair, where Mia and her newborn pups are hiding out. See the babies' first swimming lessons before the clan moves to new digs, and welcome an era of otter peace as the Mangrove Family becomes a park's main attraction.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue Season 1
programme.desc: Venture to the pristine wilderness of the Snares Islands, a remote animal sanctuary protected from the turbulent sea. Hop along with a colony of Snares crested penguins, soar with giant petrels and sooty shearwaters, and roar with giant sea lions.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Set sail for New Zealand's Otago Peninsula, a breeding refuge for endangered seabirds and marine mammals. Watch as sea lions, albatrosses, red-billed gulls, white-fronted terns, and fairy prions find mates, then nurture the next generation.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Uncover a land of opposites atop New Zealand's South Island, where one of the world's longest sandbars attracts bar-tailed godwits and hungry pilot whales, and drowned river valleys provide a buffet for dusky dolphins and New Zealand fur seals.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: Bow down to one of nature's most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

programme.title: Deep Dive Australia Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Say goodbye to the tropics and dip into cool southern-coast waters. Come face to face with majestic grey nurse sharks, shape-shifting cuttlefish, and huge blue whales; play with penguins and sea lions; and learn why these seas are brimming with life.

programme.title: Deep Dive Australia Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Complete the trip's final lap in the untamed lands where Australia's interior desert meets the hot, hostile Indian Ocean. Confront the challenges of survival in this region as Lizzie dives with tiger sharks, manta rays, and nomadic turtles.

programme.title: Deep Dive Australia Season 1
programme.desc: Explore the shores of the Northern Territory and the abundant waters of the Great Barrier Reef. Face flooded roads, hungry saltwater crocs, and killer jellyfish as Lizzie investigates why so many strange, deadly creatures make this remote area home.

programme.title: City Wildlife Rescue Season 1 Episode 12
programme.desc: Check in with the centre's resident turkey vulture, who's ready for release and in search of a flock. While Nathalie and her team rush to secure funding for a new facility, the medical team is baffled by a toad who has mysteriously taken ill.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Koala Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Koalas may seem solitary and inert, but mating season brings a dramatic shift in their behavior, leading to movement, contact, and conflict. As breeding season begins, follow two large males on a mission to mate.

programme.title: Animal Empires Season 1 Episode 6
programme.desc: Epic flights, adventurous sea journeys and exhausting road trips all play a key part in the lives of many species. These empires travel in search of food, shelter or a mate. But booking and organizing travel is no easy feat when those plans involve hundreds – even thousands – of individuals.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong Season 1
programme.desc: The source of the Mekong River is high up in the Tibetan plateau, from there it flows into Yunnan Province, China, where our journey begins. Even though Yunnan occupies less than 4% of China's land, it is home to over half of its birds and mammals.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Steep mountains and tropical monsoons define the Mekong River valley on its route through Laos. Catch glimpses of the wildlife who find refuge in its vibrant ecosystems, from stump-tailed macaques to pied kingfishers to black-crested gibbons.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: The temperate north meets the tropical south along the Mekong's banks in Thailand. Follow the river through the Golden Triangle and see the courtship dances of the region's abundant bird species. Then take in a festival honouring water spirits.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: Explore the stunning caves of Khammouane province in Laos. These natural wonders, squeezed between the Mekong River and the Annamite Range, are home to part-time and full-time residents, including bats, geckos, frogs, and giant centipedes.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: As the Mekong River travels down Thailand's eastern border, it sculpts the land, creating hundreds of small waterways through the jungle. Take a trek though lands where rhesus macaques, elephants, and flying foxes live in harmony at the water's edge.

programme.title: Wild Crusades Season 1
programme.desc: The forests of Yala National Park are home to the enigmatic sloth bear. Shy by nature, this animal is seldom seen and rarely filmed. Join a team of wildlife filmmakers as they reveal this mysterious bear's life and behaviour as never seen before.

programme.title: Wild Crusades Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: There's a new arrival at the Elephant Transit Home: a sick elephant calf abandoned near a reserve, another victim in the battle for space between humans and elephants. Study the innovative efforts to end this conflict, led by Dr. Pruthu Fernando.

programme.title: Wild Crusades Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Hidden in the jungles of Sri Lanka is the toque macaque. Endemic to the island, these feisty group-living monkeys are found nowhere else on earth. And they are at the heart of the longest primate research project ever undertaken. Dr Wolfgang Dittus is on a quest to understand their complex society.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School Season 2
programme.desc: Witness some big changes when four cute new arrivals join the nursery classes. And for a handful of adolescent males that are growing too big and boisterous for their babysitters, it's their last day at forest school.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School Season 2 Episode 2
programme.desc: Crash a fruit-flinging party celebrating the return of Jelapat, Talaken, Bawan, and Rona to the nursery to join the rest of their classmates. Meanwhile, flooding overtakes the pre-release islands, and injuries stifle the progress of two students.

programme.title: Great Blue Wild Season 2 Episode 2
programme.desc: Palau is a tiny country with a big story. In 2009, this island nation in the middle of the western Pacific Ocean created the world's first shark sanctuary to protect more than 100 shark species from reckless overfishing and the brutal practice of commercial shark finning. Then, in 2014, Palau once again led the way. It established the world's largest marine sanctuary – a no-go zone for foreign commercial fisheries nearly the size of California.

programme.title: Great Blue Wild Season 2 Episode 8
programme.desc: The Pacific coast of Costa Rica is a biodiversity hotspot that hosts nearly 5,000 species of marine life. But here in this undersea jungle, the ocean's top predator is at risk. Discover how marine defenders are teaming up to save the shark.

programme.title: Great Blue Wild Season 3 Episode 3
programme.desc: The coast of Mozambique is home to giants, like humpbacks and whale sharks, but the tiniest species play just as big of a role in the ecosystem. Meet the scientists who are working against the clock to protect coastal creatures big and small.

programme.title: Shark Squad Season 1
programme.desc: Off Guadalupe Island, Mexico, top shark ecologist Mauricio Hoyos attempts a television first. Get a unique view as he attaches a camera to the dorsal fin of a great white, revealing how it swims, hunts, and ultimately strikes its prey.

programme.title: Shark Squad Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Travel to a remote part of the Bahamas to unlock shark secrets. Do they make friends? Where do they give birth? Are some bolder than others? The answers may help protect these supreme predators for generations to come.

programme.title: Shark Squad Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: In some of the most-remote regions on the planet, researchers dive deep and brave danger to unlock secret shark behaviours, challenge myths about sharks, and fight for the protection of these supreme predators – before it's too late.

programme.title: Shark Squad Season 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: Often portrayed as mindless eating machines prone to attacking humans, sharks are more complex and intelligent than previously thought. Find out how these graceful top predators interact, choose friends, and even teach other sharks.

programme.title: Baby Animals Season 1
programme.desc: Elephants, gorillas, rhinos, and bison are among the largest and most imposing land-dwelling mammals, but they all start out as helpless infants. See how babies from each species find their way to becoming giants.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Year Season 1
programme.desc: In Southern Africa, Spring starts in early September and the natural world stirs into life. Days begin to lengthen, temperatures rise, and animals and plants combine in an orchestrated effort to reproduce, give birth and raise their young.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Year Season 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Summer in Africa is a season of extremes, it separates the weak from the strong. It tests the survival instincts of cheetahs, lions, geckos, turtles and many more species as they search for food and water in the extreme heat of summer.

programme.title: Beasts of the Big Blue Season 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Uncover a land of opposites atop New Zealand's South Island, where one of the world's longest sandbars attracts bar-tailed godwits and hungry pilot whales, and drowned river valleys provide a buffet for dusky dolphins and New Zealand fur seals.

programme.title: Jaguar Journals Season 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: Watch the Onçafari team get to know Aroeira, their newly collared female, and take a peek at Aurora's cub, Apolo. Continue to track Badalo, who has moved deeper into the flooded forest, where he puts Lizzie's game-changing research in jeopardy.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters Season 3
programme.desc: While the dominant males roam nearby territories, hunting duties fall to the Mwamba pride's nine strong lionesses. See how they cope with the approach of the rainy season and six growing teenagers with boundless appetites.

programme.title: Big Cat Country Season 1
programme.desc: When the all-female Hollywood pride encounters the Nomads, a new pride of rival males, they may have found the answer to their mating dry spell. But they quickly realize that it will not be a happy encounter.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School Season 2 Episode 3
programme.desc: Watch a milestone moment when two students get their first forest time in years. And another pair of students are confined to the school's clinic after an accident in the forest leaves Beni with a broken leg and Lala with a broken elbow.

programme.desc: The Hollywood pride reels after the Nomad's brutal attack on their leader, Ava, leaves her desperately weak and unable to hunt. To add to her woes, her hungry pride start rejecting her. But without her, they struggle to bring down prey.

programme.desc: Beni and Lala are going stir crazy in the sick bay, but they must recover before returning to the rough and tumble of class. And at forest school, a termite-foraging lesson inspires class clown Valentino to make a finger-licking discovery.

programme.title: Vivy -Fluorite Eye's Song- Episode 3
programme.desc: Vivy seeks to understand what it means to put her heart into something. She works as a temporary staff at Space Hotel Sunrise, in an attempt to prevent its drop to Earth.

programme.title: Vivy -Fluorite Eye's Song- Episode 4
programme.desc: Sunrise begins to lose control earlier than Matsumoto's calculations. Vivy investigates amidst the chaos, in a bid to save the passengers and Momoko's sister, Yuzuka.

programme.title: Vivy -Fluorite Eye's Song- Episode 5
programme.desc: Professor Tatsuya tells Vivy about Metal Float, the first fully AI-operated plant manufacturing parts and components for AIs around the clock. She aims to stop all its functions, to prevent AIs from destroying humans in future.

programme.title: Vivy -Fluorite Eye's Song- Episode 6
programme.desc: Professor Tatsuya's real motivations for wanting to halt the Metal Float is revealed.

programme.title: Vivy -Fluorite Eye's Song- Episode 7
programme.desc: Vivy is part of the lineup in the Zodiac Signs Fes, a music festival held with 12 humanoid diva AIs. An odd occurrence during the rehearsal gives her a new direction.

programme.title: Vivy -Fluorite Eye's Song- Episode 8
programme.desc: Vivy and Matsumoto try to prevent Ophelia's suicide attempt. Matsumoto uncovers Ophelia's true self.

programme.title: Vivy -Fluorite Eye's Song- Episode 9
programme.desc: As partners, Vivy and Matsumoto fight their individual battle. Vivy continues her quest to put her heart in her song.

programme.title: Vivy -Fluorite Eye's Song- Episode 10
programme.desc: Having lost the ability to sing, Vivy retires from performing and rests in a museum for AI technology. While searching for a new path, she finds inspiration from her life and in those she meets.

programme.title: Vivy -Fluorite Eye's Song- Episode 11
programme.desc: Project Singularity has failed. The Collective AI Database Archive announces the falling of all orbital satellites.

programme.title: Vivy -Fluorite Eye's Song- Episode 12
programme.desc: According to Archive's computation, humanity is on the verge of annihilation. With Toak's cooperation, Vivy embarks on a new mission to prevent the tragedy.

programme.title: Vivy -Fluorite Eye's Song- Episode 13
programme.desc: Project Singularity is executed. Vivy finds out what it means to put her heart into her song.

programme.title: The Case Study of Vanitas Episode 7

programme.title: The Case Study of Vanitas Episode 8

programme.title: Migi & Dali Episode 7

programme.title: Migi & Dali Episode 8
programme.desc: Shocked by Sally's true identity, Migi decides to leave Dali and pursue freedom. Dali vows to their late mother that he will exact revenge, even if he is on his own.

programme.desc: 南飞和家宜这对好友都面临婚姻的考题：南飞的恋人陈放对婚姻犹豫不决而未能离开前妻；家宜在结婚前夕突然明白婚姻应该为爱情而非安全感。南飞于是放下工作与陈放，到贫困地区帮助弱势的一群找回自信。家宜与焦岳在携手进行房屋改造中产生微妙的感情。千回百转，南飞与陈放、家宜与焦岳，终于看清了自己的内心，收获婚姻与爱情，领悟了美好生活的真谛。

programme.desc: 太平年》描绘了一幅从旌旗猎猎的烽火中原，到市列珠玑的繁华吴越，乱世纷纭、阳谋天下的五代十国史诗画卷。钱弘俶、赵匡胤、郭荣三位有志青年经历了家国动乱、秩序崩溃、生灵涂炭后，逐渐认识到只有国家一统才能摆脱战火国殇。郭荣在尸山血海中重拾国家秩序，壮志未酬，英雄气短；赵匡胤在历史转折之时建立北宋政权，严明军纪，改革弊政，安定民生，慎用兵戈，一扫五代丧乱之颓风，向着天下太平一步步迈进。最终，在北宋统一的大势和天下黎庶的企盼面前，吴越王钱弘俶封疆献土，“纳土归宋”，完成了中国历史上一次伟大的统一。Set during the turbulent Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, the drama draws inspiration from a major historical turning point over a thousand years ago. Amid war, political collapse, and widespread suffering, Qian Hong Chu, Zhao Kuang Yin, and Guo...

programme.title: 非常检控观 / The Unusual Prosecutor Episode 10
programme.desc: 刑事检控专员包希仁因患有“镜反射触觉症”而拥有异于常人的触觉及同理心。他致力还原案件的真相，誓要还受害者一个公道。在伸张正义的过程中，他面对了家庭与情感上的重重阻力，但仍坚持信念，为受害者争取公道与真相。A prosecutor with “mirror-touch synaesthesia” - a rare neurological condition, is determined to uncover the full truth in criminal cases and encourage guilty pleas to protect victims from long trials. Despite facing personal and professional conflicts—including clashes with his powerful mother and a former lover—he remains committed to delivering justice and truth for victims.

programme.title: 综艺新时代 / New Style Episode 15
programme.desc: 【综艺新时代】，发现台湾好所在。三位主持秉持“主持职人“的精神，以诙谐搞笑的方式，到台湾368个乡镇走透透，把台湾各地专业职人为台湾这片土地所做的努力介绍给观众。Spanning all 368 townships of Taiwan, this lively trio shines a light on local craftsmen—masters of their trade whose passion, grit, and love for the land reveal the island’s truest charm.

programme.title: 百味人生 / Bittersweet Destiny
programme.desc: 【百味人生】是一部以料理为引线，交织情感、人性与台湾文化的原创戏剧。故事围绕一位总舖师因为一宗陷害事件，使其女儿与五位徒弟从分崩离析到彼此纠葛，呈现横跨25年的恩怨情仇与家族纠结。剧中每一段故事，都对应一道人生滋味，展现爱情的甜、亲情的苦、背叛的辣、梦想的酸与欲望的咸，融合台湾人饮食文化与庶民记忆，勾勒出在生命里最熟悉的味道与情感，透过时代转变与两代间的冲突，诉说成长与和解的历程，是一部结合文化深度与情感张力的戏剧。Bittersweet Destiny is a Taiwanese original series that uses cuisine as the connecting thread to weave together themes of emotion, human nature, and Taiwanese culture. The story is sparked by a frame-up incident involving a master chef, which causes his daughter and five apprentices to ...

programme.title: 大地餐桌 第一季 / Earthly Ambrosia S1
programme.desc: 《大地餐桌》走访西南乡野，探寻当地饮食文化，以人物故事串连食材、菜肴与本土的饮食习惯，展现当地滋味与食物有关的情感故事。The series traverses the countryside of southwest China in exploration of the local food culture, connecting the local produce with dishes through personal stories, showcasing the local flavors.

programme.title: 非常检控观 / The Unusual Prosecutor Episode 11
programme.desc: 刑事检控专员包希仁因患有“镜反射触觉症”而拥有异于常人的触觉及同理心。他致力还原案件的真相，誓要还受害者一个公道。在伸张正义的过程中，他面对了家庭与情感上的重重阻力，但仍坚持信念，为受害者争取公道与真相。A prosecutor with “mirror-touch synaesthesia” - a rare neurological condition, is determined to uncover the full truth in criminal cases and encourage guilty pleas to protect victims from long trials. Despite facing personal and professional conflicts—including clashes with his powerful mother and a former lover—he remains committed to delivering justice and truth for victims.

programme.title: 百味人生 / Bittersweet Destiny
programme.desc: 【百味人生】是一部以料理为引线，交织情感、人性与台湾文化的原创戏剧。故事围绕一位总舖师因为一宗陷害事件，使其女儿与五位徒弟从分崩离析到彼此纠葛，呈现横跨25年的恩怨情仇与家族纠结。剧中每一段故事，都对应一道人生滋味，展现爱情的甜、亲情的苦、背叛的辣、梦想的酸与欲望的咸，融合台湾人饮食文化与庶民记忆，勾勒出在生命里最熟悉的味道与情感，透过时代转变与两代间的冲突，诉说成长与和解的历程，是一部结合文化深度与情感张力的戏剧。Bittersweet Destiny is a Taiwanese original series that uses cuisine as the connecting thread to weave together themes of emotion, human nature, and Taiwanese culture. The story is sparked by a frame-up incident involving a master chef, which causes his daughter and five apprentices to ...

programme.title: 大地餐桌 第一季 / Earthly Ambrosia S1
programme.desc: 《大地餐桌》走访西南乡野，探寻当地饮食文化，以人物故事串连食材、菜肴与本土的饮食习惯，展现当地滋味与食物有关的情感故事。The series traverses the countryside of southwest China in exploration of the local food culture, connecting the local produce with dishes through personal stories, showcasing the local flavors.

programme.desc: 一桩吸金诈骗案意外改变了三个女人的命运：有如大树般坚强的女性；如花般绽放的富家千金；也有如小草般的平凡女性。借由三个女主角来传达自信、勇气及自我价值的重要性，从爱出发能克服任何困境、挖掘出无限潜能和力量！A money-driven fraud case unexpectedly alters the destinies of three women: a resilient woman resembling a sturdy tree, a wealthy daughter blossoming like a flower, and an ordinary woman akin to grass. programme.title: 那些年，那些歌 / Memorable Classic Songs Episode 226
programme.desc:
全新音乐节目《那些年。那些歌》由音乐大师陈国华主持，邀请乐坛重量级歌王歌后，串连老、中、青三代音乐人，畅聊温馨感人的音乐故事，改编金典歌曲，用最动听的歌声，带领观众重温60、70年代的美好时光。
Memorable Classic Songs is a new music programs hosted by Chen Guo

programme.title: 大地餐桌 第一季 / Earthly Ambrosia S1 Episode 2
programme.desc: 《大地餐桌》走访西南乡野，探寻当地饮食文化，以人物故事串连食材、菜肴与本土的饮食习惯，展现当地滋味与食物有关的情感故事。The series traverses the countryside of southwest China in exploration of the local food culture, connecting the local produce with dishes through personal stories, showcasing the local flavors.

programme.title: 非常检控观 / The Unusual Prosecutor Episode 12
programme.desc: 刑事检控专员包希仁因患有“镜反射触觉症”而拥有异于常人的触觉及同理心。他致力还原案件的真相，誓要还受害者一个公道。在伸张正义的过程中，他面对了家庭与情感上的重重阻力，但仍坚持信念，为受害者争取公道与真相。A prosecutor with “mirror-touch synaesthesia” - a rare neurological condition, is determined to uncover the full truth in criminal cases and encourage guilty pleas to protect victims from long trials. Despite facing personal and professional conflicts—including clashes with his powerful mother and a former lover—he remains committed to delivering justice and truth for victims.

programme.title: 温暖的甜蜜的 / Warm And Sweet Episode 7
programme.desc: 南飞和家宜这对好友都面临婚姻的考题：南飞的恋人陈放对婚姻犹豫不决而未能离开前妻；家宜在结婚前夕突然明白婚姻应该为爱情而非安全感。南飞于是放下工作与陈放，到贫困地区帮助弱势的一群找回自信。家宜与焦岳在携手进行房屋改造中产生微妙的感情。千回百转，南飞与陈放、家宜与焦岳，终于看清了自己的内心，收获婚姻与爱情，领悟了美好生活的真谛。

programme.title: 超级冰冰Show / Super Bing Bing Show Episode 106
programme.desc: 【超级冰冰 Show】是台湾综艺大姐大白冰冰新开的大型台语综艺歌唱节目，联同主持的还有阳帆及台一线。两小时的节目，将邀请观众喜爱的老中青歌手，演唱经典或流行的台语歌曲，让观众听出耳油来。想听好歌，就千万别错过！

programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 964
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 超级夜总会精选 / Super Nightclub Specials Episode 30
programme.desc: 台湾年度最新重金推出的户外歌唱综艺秀，它是耗资了千万打造的全台唯一行动舞台车，不只会全省走透透，还会邀请超级卡司，重现当年歌舞秀的热闹风光。听好歌，看好秀，就在由超级搭档——彭恰恰,许效舜所主持的〈超级夜总会〉，〈佳乐台〉抢先火速送上。

programme.title: 超級紅人榜 / Top Singers Episode 721
programme.desc: 难得一见、以台语歌曲为主的选秀节目即将登场！〈超级红人榜〉的宗旨是为了发扬台语歌曲，提供一个平台让对台语歌曲怀有热忱的各界人士发挥所长，发掘更多的演艺人才。这个节目自从开播以来屡创收视新高，通过知性风趣的于美人和选秀出生的蔡昌宪的轻松主持，您会惊讶地发现，原来台语歌曲不是年长人士的专有，原来年轻人唱起台语经典歌曲来也是很酷的！

programme.title: 追分成功 / Define Your Own Success Episode 179
programme.desc: 这是一部现代家庭伦理剧，看同住一屋簷下的单身房客，北漂追求梦想，在收获爱情、友情的同时，也面临得到与失去。他们向往完美爱情、渴望幸福婚姻、追求事业高升，不停向前“追分”，在这一路跌撞、相互陪伴的欢笑与泪水中，定义属于自己的“成功”！This drama series follows a group of single tenants under the same roof who travelled north to pursue their dreams, love and friendship. They yearn for perfect love, long for a happy marriage, and a good career advancement. Stumbling along the way with tears and laughter, they each define success by their own standards.

They yearn for perfect love, long for a happy marriage, and a good career advancement. Stumbling along the way with tears and laughter, they each define success by their own standards.

programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 965
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 超级夜总会精选 / Super Nightclub Specials Episode 30
programme.desc: 台湾年度最新重金推出的户外歌唱综艺秀，它是耗资了千万打造的全台唯一行动舞台车，不只会全省走透透，还会邀请超级卡司，重现当年歌舞秀的热闹风光。听好歌，看好秀，就在由超级搭档——彭恰恰,许效舜所主持的〈超级夜总会〉，〈佳乐台〉抢先火速送上。

programme.title: 超级冰冰Show / Super Bing Bing Show Episode 107
programme.desc: 【超级冰冰 Show】是台湾综艺大姐大白冰冰新开的大型台语综艺歌唱节目，联同主持的还有阳帆及台一线。两小时的节目，将邀请观众喜爱的老中青歌手，演唱经典或流行的台语歌曲，让观众听出耳油来。想听好歌，就千万别错过！

programme.title: 大地餐桌 第一季 / Earthly Ambrosia S1 Episode 2
programme.desc: 《大地餐桌》走访西南乡野，探寻当地饮食文化，以人物故事串连食材、菜肴与本土的饮食习惯，展现当地滋味与食物有关的情感故事。The series traverses the countryside of southwest China in exploration of the local food culture, connecting the local produce with dishes through personal stories, showcasing the local flavors.

programme.title: 超級紅人榜 / Top Singers Episode 722
programme.desc: 难得一见、以台语歌曲为主的选秀节目即将登场！〈超级红人榜〉的宗旨是为了发扬台语歌曲，提供一个平台让对台语歌曲怀有热忱的各界人士发挥所长，发掘更多的演艺人才。这个节目自从开播以来屡创收视新高，通过知性风趣的于美人和选秀出生的蔡昌宪的轻松主持，您会惊讶地发现，原来台语歌曲不是年长人士的专有，原来年轻人唱起台语经典歌曲来也是很酷的！

programme.title: 综艺新时代 / New Style Episode 16
programme.desc: 【综艺新时代】，发现台湾好所在。三位主持秉持“主持职人“的精神，以诙谐搞笑的方式，到台湾368个乡镇走透透，把台湾各地专业职人为台湾这片土地所做的努力介绍给观众。Spanning all 368 townships of Taiwan, this lively trio shines a light on local craftsmen—masters of their trade whose passion, grit, and love for the land reveal the island’s truest charm.

programme.title: 温暖的甜蜜的 / Warm And Sweet Episode 7
programme.desc: 南飞和家宜这对好友都面临婚姻的考题：南飞的恋人陈放对婚姻犹豫不决而未能离开前妻；家宜在结婚前夕突然明白婚姻应该为爱情而非安全感。南飞于是放下工作与陈放，到贫困地区帮助弱势的一群找回自信。家宜与焦岳在携手进行房屋改造中产生微妙的感情。千回百转，南飞与陈放、家宜与焦岳，终于看清了自己的内心，收获婚姻与爱情，领悟了美好生活的真谛。

programme.title: 那些年，那些歌 / Memorable Classic Songs Episode 226
programme.desc:
全新音乐节目《那些年。那些歌》由音乐大师陈国华主持，邀请乐坛重量级歌王歌后，串连老、中、青三代音乐人，畅聊温馨感人的音乐故事，改编金典歌曲，用最动听的歌声，带领观众重温60、70年代的美好时光。
Memorable Classic Songs is a new music programs hosted by Chen Guo

programme.title: 非常检控观 / The Unusual Prosecutor Episode 12
programme.desc: 刑事检控专员包希仁因患有“镜反射触觉症”而拥有异于常人的触觉及同理心。他致力还原案件的真相，誓要还受害者一个公道。在伸张正义的过程中，他面对了家庭与情感上的重重阻力，但仍坚持信念，为受害者争取公道与真相。A prosecutor with “mirror-touch synaesthesia” - a rare neurological condition, is determined to uncover the full truth in criminal cases and encourage guilty pleas to protect victims from long trials. Despite facing personal and professional conflicts—including clashes with his powerful mother and a former lover—he remains committed to delivering justice and truth for victims.

programme.title: 百味人生 / Bittersweet Destiny Episode 2
programme.desc: 【百味人生】是一部以料理为引线，交织情感、人性与台湾文化的原创戏剧。故事围绕一位总舖师因为一宗陷害事件，使其女儿与五位徒弟从分崩离析到彼此纠葛，呈现横跨25年的恩怨情仇与家族纠结。剧中每一段故事，都对应一道人生滋味，展现爱情的甜、亲情的苦、背叛的辣、梦想的酸与欲望的咸，融合台湾人饮食文化与庶民记忆，勾勒出在生命里最熟悉的味道与情感，透过时代转变与两代间的冲突，诉说成长与和解的历程，是一部结合文化深度与情感张力的戏剧。Bittersweet Destiny is a Taiwanese original series that uses cuisine as the connecting thread to weave together themes of emotion, human nature, and Taiwanese culture. programme.title: 爱的荣耀 / Glory of Love Episode 244
programme.desc: 一桩吸金诈骗案意外改变了三个女人的命运：有如大树般坚强的女性；如花般绽放的富家千金；也有如小草般的平凡女性。借由三个女主角来传达自信、勇气及自我价值的重要性，从爱出发能克服任何困境、挖掘出无限潜能和力量！A money-driven fraud case unexpectedly alters the destinies of three women: a resilient woman resembling a sturdy tree, a wealthy daughter blossoming like a flower, and an ordinary woman akin to grass. programme.desc: 太平年》描绘了一幅从旌旗猎猎的烽火中原，到市列珠玑的繁华吴越，乱世纷纭、阳谋天下的五代十国史诗画卷。钱弘俶、赵匡胤、郭荣三位有志青年经历了家国动乱、秩序崩溃、生灵涂炭后，逐渐认识到只有国家一统才能摆脱战火国殇。郭荣在尸山血海中重拾国家秩序，壮志未酬，英雄气短；赵匡胤在历史转折之时建立北宋政权，严明军纪，改革弊政，安定民生，慎用兵戈，一扫五代丧乱之颓风，向着天下太平一步步迈进。最终，在北宋统一的大势和天下黎庶的企盼面前，吴越王钱弘俶封疆献土，“纳土归宋”，完成了中国历史上一次伟大的统一。Set during the turbulent Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, the drama draws inspiration from a major historical turning point over a thousand years ago. programme.desc: 刑事检控专员包希仁因患有“镜反射触觉症”而拥有异于常人的触觉及同理心。他致力还原案件的真相，誓要还受害者一个公道。在伸张正义的过程中，他面对了家庭与情感上的重重阻力，但仍坚持信念，为受害者争取公道与真相。A prosecutor with “mirror-touch synaesthesia” - a rare neurological condition, is determined to uncover the full truth in criminal cases and encourage guilty pleas to protect victims from long trials. Despite facing personal and professional conflicts—including clashes with his powerful mother and a former lover—he remains committed to delivering justice and truth for victims.

programme.title: 温暖的甜蜜的 / Warm And Sweet Episode 8
programme.desc: 南飞和家宜这对好友都面临婚姻的考题：南飞的恋人陈放对婚姻犹豫不决而未能离开前妻；家宜在结婚前夕突然明白婚姻应该为爱情而非安全感。南飞于是放下工作与陈放，到贫困地区帮助弱势的一群找回自信。家宜与焦岳在携手进行房屋改造中产生微妙的感情。千回百转，南飞与陈放、家宜与焦岳，终于看清了自己的内心，收获婚姻与爱情，领悟了美好生活的真谛。

programme.title: 太平年 / Swords Into PlowShares Episode 26
programme.desc: 太平年》描绘了一幅从旌旗猎猎的烽火中原，到市列珠玑的繁华吴越，乱世纷纭、阳谋天下的五代十国史诗画卷。钱弘俶、赵匡胤、郭荣三位有志青年经历了家国动乱、秩序崩溃、生灵涂炭后，逐渐认识到只有国家一统才能摆脱战火国殇。郭荣在尸山血海中重拾国家秩序，壮志未酬，英雄气短；赵匡胤在历史转折之时建立北宋政权，严明军纪，改革弊政，安定民生，慎用兵戈，一扫五代丧乱之颓风，向着天下太平一步步迈进。最终，在北宋统一的大势和天下黎庶的企盼面前，吴越王钱弘俶封疆献土，“纳土归宋”，完成了中国历史上一次伟大的统一。Set during the turbulent Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, the drama draws inspiration from a major historical turning point over a thousand years ago. Amid war, political collapse, and widespread suffering, Qian Hong Chu, Zhao Kuang Yin, and Guo...

programme.title: 天知道 / Fate's Secret Episode 29
programme.desc: 本剧由白冰冰担任制作人并领衔主演，集结了超坚强的卡司，包括资深戏骨及新生代演员，以现代生活为背景，讲述了玄天上帝在人间济世救人、感化世间暴戾的感人故事。剧情强调“善的力量”与因果报应，展现信仰如何感化世间的种种恶行与怨气，是一部正向感人、充满信念的作品。Produced and led by Bai Bingbing, this series features a star-studded cast comprising veterans and upcoming stars. programme.desc: 【百味人生】是一部以料理为引线，交织情感、人性与台湾文化的原创戏剧。故事围绕一位总舖师因为一宗陷害事件，使其女儿与五位徒弟从分崩离析到彼此纠葛，呈现横跨25年的恩怨情仇与家族纠结。剧中每一段故事，都对应一道人生滋味，展现爱情的甜、亲情的苦、背叛的辣、梦想的酸与欲望的咸，融合台湾人饮食文化与庶民记忆，勾勒出在生命里最熟悉的味道与情感，透过时代转变与两代间的冲突，诉说成长与和解的历程，是一部结合文化深度与情感张力的戏剧。Bittersweet Destiny is a Taiwanese original series that uses cuisine as the connecting thread to weave together themes of emotion, human nature, and Taiwanese culture. programme.title: 非常检控观 / The Unusual Prosecutor Episode 14
programme.desc: 刑事检控专员包希仁因患有“镜反射触觉症”而拥有异于常人的触觉及同理心。他致力还原案件的真相，誓要还受害者一个公道。在伸张正义的过程中，他面对了家庭与情感上的重重阻力，但仍坚持信念，为受害者争取公道与真相。A prosecutor with “mirror-touch synaesthesia” - a rare neurological condition, is determined to uncover the full truth in criminal cases and encourage guilty pleas to protect victims from long trials. Despite facing personal and professional conflicts—including clashes with his powerful mother and a former lover—he remains committed to delivering justice and truth for victims.

programme.title: 欢迎光临二代咖啡 / Would You Like A Cup Of Coffee?
programme.desc: “二代咖啡店”老板卜硕每天为客人精心烹煮一杯杯充满救赎的咖啡，从上班族到家庭主妇，日复一日，他的咖啡资历早已在业界写下一页传奇。江湖传闻他从不收徒弟，却在遇见对成为咖啡师充满憧憬的江克平后悄然改变……。Cafe owner Park makes coffee for coffee addicts of all kinds and his track records have made him a legend in the industry. Rumour has it that he does not take in apprentices, until he cross paths with Jiang, whose dream is to become a barista.

programme.title: 在暴雪时分 / Amidst a Snowstorm of Love Episode 9
programme.desc: 昔日天才级职业斯诺克选手林亦扬与当红九球选手殷果相遇在一场十年难得一遇的暴雪之夜。在殷果表弟的助攻之下，两人慢慢熟识。殷果也了解到林亦扬的往事。原来林亦扬曾经也是轰动一时的斯诺克天才，在一次比赛中因对裁判判罚有异议，争取时无意冲撞裁判而被禁赛，少年气盛的他不服判决，竟直接宣布退役，从此离开了自己引以为傲的斯诺克事业。殷果的出现，让林亦扬的人生轨迹再次转变，林亦扬不仅开始努力地追求殷果，还在殷果的带动下重拾最初的梦想，返回斯诺克赛场。最终二人共攀事业高峰，一同为职业台球事业贡献力量，并携手教练与队友，共推全民健身台球项目发展。

programme.title: 祈今朝 / Sword and Fairy Episode 5
programme.desc: 越今朝和越祈二人在乌岩村相伴三年，有着神奇的“共鸣”关系，却对各自的身世一无所知。二人携手闯荡江湖，希望找回过往记忆。双越二人被卷入启魂圣宗作乱和洛家堡血祭等神秘事件之中，而在对抗圣宗过程中意外让越祈被封印的回忆和情感被开启。随着事件发展，双越结识了洛家堡双子洛埋名和洛昭言、千年狼妖闲卿、顾寒江和明绣师徒以及居十方等江湖人士，二人的真实身份也逐渐揭开。

programme.title: 雨霖铃 / Zhan Zhao Adventures
programme.desc: 《雨霖铃》讲述了武功高强、正直无私的御前四品带刀护卫的展昭，在收到故友留下的悬案证据后只身探寻线索，却遭遇各方势力袭杀，并在途中结识了玲珑山庄大小姐霍玲珑以及“锦毛鼠”白玉堂。志同道合的三人在一次次出生入死后，终于逐渐靠近事情的真相……Huo Linglong, a young maiden entering the martial world, encounters the mysterious swordsman Zhan Rifeng, later revealed to be Zhan Zhao，the Southern Hero. Gravely poisoned and pursued, Zhan Zhao entrusts incriminating evidence against Prince Xiangyang to Huo Linglong before sacrificing himself as bait to protect the people. Huo Linglong narrowly escapes with the aid of Bai Yu...

programme.title: 欢迎光临二代咖啡 / Would You Like A Cup Of Coffee? Episode 3

programme.title: 祈今朝 / Sword and Fairy Episode 7
programme.desc: 越今朝和越祈二人在乌岩村相伴三年，有着神奇的“共鸣”关系，却对各自的身世一无所知。二人携手闯荡江湖，希望找回过往记忆。双越二人被卷入启魂圣宗作乱和洛家堡血祭等神秘事件之中，而在对抗圣宗过程中意外让越祈被封印的回忆和情感被开启。随着事件发展，双越结识了洛家堡双子洛埋名和洛昭言、千年狼妖闲卿、顾寒江和明绣师徒以及居十方等江湖人士，二人的真实身份也逐渐揭开。

programme.title: 雨霖铃 / Zhan Zhao Adventures Episode 3
programme.desc: 《雨霖铃》讲述了武功高强、正直无私的御前四品带刀护卫的展昭，在收到故友留下的悬案证据后只身探寻线索，却遭遇各方势力袭杀，并在途中结识了玲珑山庄大小姐霍玲珑以及“锦毛鼠”白玉堂。志同道合的三人在一次次出生入死后，终于逐渐靠近事情的真相……Huo Linglong, a young maiden entering the martial world, encounters the mysterious swordsman Zhan Rifeng, later revealed to be Zhan Zhao，the Southern Hero. Gravely poisoned and pursued, Zhan Zhao entrusts incriminating evidence against Prince Xiangyang to Huo Linglong before sacrificing himself as bait to protect the people. Huo Linglong narrowly escapes with the aid of Bai Yu...

programme.title: 欢迎光临二代咖啡 / Would You Like A Cup Of Coffee? Episode 5
programme.desc: “二代咖啡店”老板卜硕每天为客人精心烹煮一杯杯充满救赎的咖啡，从上班族到家庭主妇，日复一日，他的咖啡资历早已在业界写下一页传奇。江湖传闻他从不收徒弟，却在遇见对成为咖啡师充满憧憬的江克平后悄然改变……。Cafe owner Park makes coffee for coffee addicts of all kinds and his track records have made him a legend in the industry. Rumour has it that he does not take in apprentices, until he cross paths with Jiang, whose dream is to become a barista.

programme.title: 祈今朝 / Sword and Fairy Episode 7
programme.desc: 越今朝和越祈二人在乌岩村相伴三年，有着神奇的“共鸣”关系，却对各自的身世一无所知。二人携手闯荡江湖，希望找回过往记忆。双越二人被卷入启魂圣宗作乱和洛家堡血祭等神秘事件之中，而在对抗圣宗过程中意外让越祈被封印的回忆和情感被开启。随着事件发展，双越结识了洛家堡双子洛埋名和洛昭言、千年狼妖闲卿、顾寒江和明绣师徒以及居十方等江湖人士，二人的真实身份也逐渐揭开。

programme.title: 温暖的甜蜜的 / Warm And Sweet Episode 35
programme.desc: 南飞和家宜这对好友都面临婚姻的考题：南飞的恋人陈放对婚姻犹豫不决而未能离开前妻；家宜在结婚前夕突然明白婚姻应该为爱情而非安全感。南飞于是放下工作与陈放，到贫困地区帮助弱势的一群找回自信。家宜与焦岳在携手进行房屋改造中产生微妙的感情。千回百转，南飞与陈放、家宜与焦岳，终于看清了自己的内心，收获婚姻与爱情，领悟了美好生活的真谛。

programme.title: 春色寄情人 / Will Love In Spring Episode 5
programme.desc: 陈麦冬年少时性格桀骜，遭遇生活变故后选择成为一名遗体整容师。庄洁则因车祸致残，为了追逐更好的自己，孤身在外打拼成为大城市之中的职场精英。一个是性格桀骜但身心孤独的遗体整容师，一个是身体缺陷但勇敢耀眼的医疗销售，在不断拉扯中逐渐互相理解与尊重，以爱治愈了彼此的“不完美”。

programme.title: 桃花映江山 / The Princess' Gambit Episode 27
programme.desc: 《桃花映江山》讲述了祁国左相沈在野因一次政敌处心积虑的陷害，与北苑国和亲公主姜桃花相识，一个腹黑狠辣，一个狡猾伶俐，在波谲云诡的两朝时局之下，二人斗智斗勇、互相算计，在面对强敌的被迫合作中又暗生情愫，在面对国家与爱情的选择，他们突破重重阻碍，共谋定江山……。The drama tells the story of a fallen princess forced into a political marriage with a corrupt prime minister. She faces numerous dangers but strives to survive to protect herself amidst the conflicts of national loyalty, personal vengeance, and true love. Meanwhile, the prime minister, outwardly ambitious to become a treacherous official, secretly harbours a desire...

programme.title: 夏日奇妙书 / My Marvellous Fable Episode 13
programme.desc: 实习编辑冯天蓝加入出版社的第一份任务就是去催畅销作家王葡萄的稿件，而她交稿的条件就是让冯天蓝从北京开车送她回老家琼海！在回乡的旅程中，王葡萄开始说一些真假参杂的故事，冯天蓝在整理书稿中拼凑出了王葡萄的人生，而王葡萄也在创作中反思自我。两个心中有伤的人展开了互相治愈的浪漫奇幻之旅。

programme.title: 太平年 / Swords Into PlowShares
programme.desc: 太平年》描绘了一幅从旌旗猎猎的烽火中原，到市列珠玑的繁华吴越，乱世纷纭、阳谋天下的五代十国史诗画卷。钱弘俶、赵匡胤、郭荣三位有志青年经历了家国动乱、秩序崩溃、生灵涂炭后，逐渐认识到只有国家一统才能摆脱战火国殇。郭荣在尸山血海中重拾国家秩序，壮志未酬，英雄气短；赵匡胤在历史转折之时建立北宋政权，严明军纪，改革弊政，安定民生，慎用兵戈，一扫五代丧乱之颓风，向着天下太平一步步迈进。最终，在北宋统一的大势和天下黎庶的企盼面前，吴越王钱弘俶封疆献土，“纳土归宋”，完成了中国历史上一次伟大的统一。Set during the turbulent Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, the drama draws inspiration from a major historical turning point over a thousand years ago. Amid war, political collapse, and widespread suffering, Qian Hong Chu, Zhao Kuang Yin, and Guo...

programme.desc: 剧集改编自南派三叔同名小说，民国初年南洋地区发生了一系列诡异事件，张海楼和张海侠两位南部档案馆的秘密探员被委派调查一起神秘案件，发现案件背后隐藏着军阀利用剧毒植物“黄昏草”散播的阴谋。在调查过程中，张海楼和张海侠经历了生死考验，张海侠甚至因此瘫痪。随着线索逐渐清晰，张海楼发现所有线索都指向一艘大船 - 南安号。 剧集改编自南派三叔同名小说，民国初年南洋地区发生了一系列诡异事件，张海楼和张海侠两位南部档案馆的秘密探员被委派调查一起神秘案件，发现案件背后隐藏着军阀利用剧毒植物“黄昏草”散播的阴谋。在调查过程中，张海楼和张海侠经历了生死考验，张海侠甚至因此瘫痪。随着线索逐渐清晰，张海楼发现所有线索都指向一艘大船 - 南安号。

programme.title: 在暴雪时分 / Amidst a Snowstorm of Love Episode 15
programme.desc: 昔日天才级职业斯诺克选手林亦扬与当红九球选手殷果相遇在一场十年难得一遇的暴雪之夜。在殷果表弟的助攻之下，两人慢慢熟识。殷果也了解到林亦扬的往事。原来林亦扬曾经也是轰动一时的斯诺克天才，在一次比赛中因对裁判判罚有异议，争取时无意冲撞裁判而被禁赛，少年气盛的他不服判决，竟直接宣布退役，从此离开了自己引以为傲的斯诺克事业。殷果的出现，让林亦扬的人生轨迹再次转变，林亦扬不仅开始努力地追求殷果，还在殷果的带动下重拾最初的梦想，返回斯诺克赛场。最终二人共攀事业高峰，一同为职业台球事业贡献力量，并携手教练与队友，共推全民健身台球项目发展。

programme.title: 祈今朝 / Sword and Fairy Episode 9
programme.desc: 越今朝和越祈二人在乌岩村相伴三年，有着神奇的“共鸣”关系，却对各自的身世一无所知。二人携手闯荡江湖，希望找回过往记忆。双越二人被卷入启魂圣宗作乱和洛家堡血祭等神秘事件之中，而在对抗圣宗过程中意外让越祈被封印的回忆和情感被开启。随着事件发展，双越结识了洛家堡双子洛埋名和洛昭言、千年狼妖闲卿、顾寒江和明绣师徒以及居十方等江湖人士，二人的真实身份也逐渐揭开。

programme.desc: 昔日天才级职业斯诺克选手林亦扬与当红九球选手殷果相遇在一场十年难得一遇的暴雪之夜。在殷果表弟的助攻之下，两人慢慢熟识。殷果也了解到林亦扬的往事。原来林亦扬曾经也是轰动一时的斯诺克天才，在一次比赛中因对裁判判罚有异议，争取时无意冲撞裁判而被禁赛，少年气盛的他不服判决，竟直接宣布退役，从此离开了自己引以为傲的斯诺克事业。殷果的出现，让林亦扬的人生轨迹再次转变，林亦扬不仅开始努力地追求殷果，还在殷果的带动下重拾最初的梦想，返回斯诺克赛场。最终二人共攀事业高峰，一同为职业台球事业贡献力量，并携手教练与队友，共推全民健身台球项目发展。

programme.title: 祈今朝 / Sword and Fairy Episode 9
programme.desc: 越今朝和越祈二人在乌岩村相伴三年，有着神奇的“共鸣”关系，却对各自的身世一无所知。二人携手闯荡江湖，希望找回过往记忆。双越二人被卷入启魂圣宗作乱和洛家堡血祭等神秘事件之中，而在对抗圣宗过程中意外让越祈被封印的回忆和情感被开启。随着事件发展，双越结识了洛家堡双子洛埋名和洛昭言、千年狼妖闲卿、顾寒江和明绣师徒以及居十方等江湖人士，二人的真实身份也逐渐揭开。

programme.title: 太平年 / Swords Into PlowShares
programme.desc: 太平年》描绘了一幅从旌旗猎猎的烽火中原，到市列珠玑的繁华吴越，乱世纷纭、阳谋天下的五代十国史诗画卷。钱弘俶、赵匡胤、郭荣三位有志青年经历了家国动乱、秩序崩溃、生灵涂炭后，逐渐认识到只有国家一统才能摆脱战火国殇。郭荣在尸山血海中重拾国家秩序，壮志未酬，英雄气短；赵匡胤在历史转折之时建立北宋政权，严明军纪，改革弊政，安定民生，慎用兵戈，一扫五代丧乱之颓风，向着天下太平一步步迈进。最终，在北宋统一的大势和天下黎庶的企盼面前，吴越王钱弘俶封疆献土，“纳土归宋”，完成了中国历史上一次伟大的统一。Set during the turbulent Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, the drama draws inspiration from a major historical turning point over a thousand years ago. Amid war, political collapse, and widespread suffering, Qian Hong Chu, Zhao Kuang Yin, and Guo...

programme.desc: 越今朝和越祈二人在乌岩村相伴三年，有着神奇的“共鸣”关系，却对各自的身世一无所知。二人携手闯荡江湖，希望找回过往记忆。双越二人被卷入启魂圣宗作乱和洛家堡血祭等神秘事件之中，而在对抗圣宗过程中意外让越祈被封印的回忆和情感被开启。随着事件发展，双越结识了洛家堡双子洛埋名和洛昭言、千年狼妖闲卿、顾寒江和明绣师徒以及居十方等江湖人士，二人的真实身份也逐渐揭开。

programme.title: 太平年 / Swords Into PlowShares Episode 3
programme.desc: 太平年》描绘了一幅从旌旗猎猎的烽火中原，到市列珠玑的繁华吴越，乱世纷纭、阳谋天下的五代十国史诗画卷。钱弘俶、赵匡胤、郭荣三位有志青年经历了家国动乱、秩序崩溃、生灵涂炭后，逐渐认识到只有国家一统才能摆脱战火国殇。郭荣在尸山血海中重拾国家秩序，壮志未酬，英雄气短；赵匡胤在历史转折之时建立北宋政权，严明军纪，改革弊政，安定民生，慎用兵戈，一扫五代丧乱之颓风，向着天下太平一步步迈进。最终，在北宋统一的大势和天下黎庶的企盼面前，吴越王钱弘俶封疆献土，“纳土归宋”，完成了中国历史上一次伟大的统一。Set during the turbulent Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, the drama draws inspiration from a major historical turning point over a thousand years ago. Amid war, political collapse, and widespread suffering, Qian Hong Chu, Zhao Kuang Yin, and Guo...

programme.desc: 剧集改编自南派三叔同名小说，民国初年南洋地区发生了一系列诡异事件，张海楼和张海侠两位南部档案馆的秘密探员被委派调查一起神秘案件，发现案件背后隐藏着军阀利用剧毒植物“黄昏草”散播的阴谋。在调查过程中，张海楼和张海侠经历了生死考验，张海侠甚至因此瘫痪。随着线索逐渐清晰，张海楼发现所有线索都指向一艘大船 - 南安号。 剧集改编自南派三叔同名小说，民国初年南洋地区发生了一系列诡异事件，张海楼和张海侠两位南部档案馆的秘密探员被委派调查一起神秘案件，发现案件背后隐藏着军阀利用剧毒植物“黄昏草”散播的阴谋。在调查过程中，张海楼和张海侠经历了生死考验，张海侠甚至因此瘫痪。随着线索逐渐清晰，张海楼发现所有线索都指向一艘大船 - 南安号。

programme.desc: 太平年》描绘了一幅从旌旗猎猎的烽火中原，到市列珠玑的繁华吴越，乱世纷纭、阳谋天下的五代十国史诗画卷。钱弘俶、赵匡胤、郭荣三位有志青年经历了家国动乱、秩序崩溃、生灵涂炭后，逐渐认识到只有国家一统才能摆脱战火国殇。郭荣在尸山血海中重拾国家秩序，壮志未酬，英雄气短；赵匡胤在历史转折之时建立北宋政权，严明军纪，改革弊政，安定民生，慎用兵戈，一扫五代丧乱之颓风，向着天下太平一步步迈进。最终，在北宋统一的大势和天下黎庶的企盼面前，吴越王钱弘俶封疆献土，“纳土归宋”，完成了中国历史上一次伟大的统一。Set during the turbulent Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, the drama draws inspiration from a major historical turning point over a thousand years ago. Amid war, political collapse, and widespread suffering, Qian Hong Chu, Zhao Kuang Yin, and Guo...

programme.desc: 剧集改编自南派三叔同名小说，民国初年南洋地区发生了一系列诡异事件，张海楼和张海侠两位南部档案馆的秘密探员被委派调查一起神秘案件，发现案件背后隐藏着军阀利用剧毒植物“黄昏草”散播的阴谋。在调查过程中，张海楼和张海侠经历了生死考验，张海侠甚至因此瘫痪。随着线索逐渐清晰，张海楼发现所有线索都指向一艘大船 - 南安号。 剧集改编自南派三叔同名小说，民国初年南洋地区发生了一系列诡异事件，张海楼和张海侠两位南部档案馆的秘密探员被委派调查一起神秘案件，发现案件背后隐藏着军阀利用剧毒植物“黄昏草”散播的阴谋。在调查过程中，张海楼和张海侠经历了生死考验，张海侠甚至因此瘫痪。随着线索逐渐清晰，张海楼发现所有线索都指向一艘大船 - 南安号。

programme.title: 在暴雪时分 / Amidst a Snowstorm of Love Episode 17
programme.desc: 昔日天才级职业斯诺克选手林亦扬与当红九球选手殷果相遇在一场十年难得一遇的暴雪之夜。在殷果表弟的助攻之下，两人慢慢熟识。殷果也了解到林亦扬的往事。原来林亦扬曾经也是轰动一时的斯诺克天才，在一次比赛中因对裁判判罚有异议，争取时无意冲撞裁判而被禁赛，少年气盛的他不服判决，竟直接宣布退役，从此离开了自己引以为傲的斯诺克事业。殷果的出现，让林亦扬的人生轨迹再次转变，林亦扬不仅开始努力地追求殷果，还在殷果的带动下重拾最初的梦想，返回斯诺克赛场。最终二人共攀事业高峰，一同为职业台球事业贡献力量，并携手教练与队友，共推全民健身台球项目发展。

programme.desc: 在二十世纪九十年代初的濠港，法官秦誉与高级督察唐萱二人曾联手将社团头目韩奎龙成功定罪。然而秦誉之子意外撞伤韩家长子后，他陷入法理与亲情的两难抉择，最终竟选择伪造证据，为掩盖真相不惜伪造证据嫁祸他人，从法律的守护者坠落为规则的挑战者，将罪责嫁祸给一名偷车少年。随着唐萱深入追查这起案件，官商勾结的暗流、警界内部的腐败，以及多桩陈年旧案的隐秘关联也逐渐浮出水面，勾勒出一幅复杂的年代罪案图景。Qin Yu, who used to be an upright judge, covered up the truth that his son caused an accident and injured the son of a gang leader in a traffic collision. To avenge his son, the gang leader stirred up a storm of bloodshed.

programme.title: 在暴雪时分 / Amidst a Snowstorm of Love Episode 19
programme.desc: 昔日天才级职业斯诺克选手林亦扬与当红九球选手殷果相遇在一场十年难得一遇的暴雪之夜。在殷果表弟的助攻之下，两人慢慢熟识。殷果也了解到林亦扬的往事。原来林亦扬曾经也是轰动一时的斯诺克天才，在一次比赛中因对裁判判罚有异议，争取时无意冲撞裁判而被禁赛，少年气盛的他不服判决，竟直接宣布退役，从此离开了自己引以为傲的斯诺克事业。殷果的出现，让林亦扬的人生轨迹再次转变，林亦扬不仅开始努力地追求殷果，还在殷果的带动下重拾最初的梦想，返回斯诺克赛场。最终二人共攀事业高峰，一同为职业台球事业贡献力量，并携手教练与队友，共推全民健身台球项目发展。

programme.title: 祈今朝 / Sword and Fairy Episode 13
programme.desc: 越今朝和越祈二人在乌岩村相伴三年，有着神奇的“共鸣”关系，却对各自的身世一无所知。二人携手闯荡江湖，希望找回过往记忆。双越二人被卷入启魂圣宗作乱和洛家堡血祭等神秘事件之中，而在对抗圣宗过程中意外让越祈被封印的回忆和情感被开启。随着事件发展，双越结识了洛家堡双子洛埋名和洛昭言、千年狼妖闲卿、顾寒江和明绣师徒以及居十方等江湖人士，二人的真实身份也逐渐揭开。

programme.title: 太平年 / Swords Into PlowShares Episode 5
programme.desc: 太平年》描绘了一幅从旌旗猎猎的烽火中原，到市列珠玑的繁华吴越，乱世纷纭、阳谋天下的五代十国史诗画卷。钱弘俶、赵匡胤、郭荣三位有志青年经历了家国动乱、秩序崩溃、生灵涂炭后，逐渐认识到只有国家一统才能摆脱战火国殇。郭荣在尸山血海中重拾国家秩序，壮志未酬，英雄气短；赵匡胤在历史转折之时建立北宋政权，严明军纪，改革弊政，安定民生，慎用兵戈，一扫五代丧乱之颓风，向着天下太平一步步迈进。最终，在北宋统一的大势和天下黎庶的企盼面前，吴越王钱弘俶封疆献土，“纳土归宋”，完成了中国历史上一次伟大的统一。Set during the turbulent Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, the drama draws inspiration from a major historical turning point over a thousand years ago. Amid war, political collapse, and widespread suffering, Qian Hong Chu, Zhao Kuang Yin, and Guo...

programme.title: 兄弟帮 / Big Boys Club Episode 378
programme.desc: 《兄弟帮》是由一班「好兄弟」林盛斌、梁竞徽、王梓轩、范振锋及陈国峰主持的年青人清谈节目，每集邀请歌手、艺人或不同界别人士作嘉宾，进行轻松访谈，带来时下社会热话、流行文化、潮流玩意等多元化内容。有关爱情、两性，以致同性关系，是男男女女谈之不尽的话题，节目邀来不同界别的嘉宾「谈情说爱」，探讨两性相处之道。「异度空间」专题，请来嘉宾分享不思议事件，如见鬼、UFO、奇人奇事等刺激话题。

programme.title: 再创世纪 / Another Era
programme.desc: 第一集 2008年，香港富豪卓啟堂千金卓定垚在布拉格街頭跳舞被扒竊，幸得賀天生相助。章明晞趕到布拉格與天生匯合，遊說彼列基金代理人但失敗。啟堂的投資主管高哲在溫哥華陪伴戀人鄭思妤時，收到美國次按危機消息無奈趕回香港。草根青年程凱在深水埗推銷新發明的移動電池，得好友朱小慧及香港首富方松蔭之孫方澤雨支持。另一方面，明晞與天生打算吞併方松蔭的天蔭集團。

programme.title: 非份之罪 & 今日知多D / Deadly Sins & What's On Today Episode 13
programme.desc: 人类的欲望，可驱使我们超越自我，然而，当欲望失控，过份贪图金钱与权势、追求不属于自己的爱，非份之想被无限放大，一不经意，便陷入道德矛盾的深渊，犯下种种「非份之罪」……新界东重案组接连调查几宗案件，包括「无脸女尸」、「石棺禁恋」、「一亿杀机」、「危险游戏」、「肮脏的子弹」、「恐怖情人」，错综复杂的线索、缠绕不清的关系，构成一桩桩匪夷所思的迷案，揭露触摸不透的人性黑暗面。

programme.title: 爱．回家之开心速递 / Lo And Behold Episode 1847
programme.desc: 熊树根(刘丹)由基层做起，他时常牵挂的只有三位宝贝女儿，大女早已移民海外、二女熊若水(吕慧仪)已届适婚年龄却嫁杏无期，经常与优异生妹妹熊心如(苏韵姿)为琐碎事争吵不休，令老爸哭笑不得。

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026 Episode 196
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 江湖见 / Journey to Jianghu (SR.2) Episode 13
programme.desc: 常言道「读万卷书不如行万里路」。黎耀祥、麦长青再次踏上旅程，继续访寻金庸先生笔下的锦绣山河，探索华夏历史中的江湖世界。他们沿长江与黄河流域游历，穿梭四川、浙江、河南、山西等地，登峨眉金顶、游白帝城、访朱仙镇岳飞庙、探嵩山少林寺，既感受历史古迹的厚重，也品尝当地特色美食。江湖不仅是刀光剑影的舞台，更是人情交错的场域。他们在旅程中亦相约米雪、陈浩民、樊少皇、吕颂贤再度聚首，忆述昔日合作点滴，笑谈往事。

programme.title: 在你的冬夜裡闪耀 / Winter Night Episode 4
programme.desc:
在城市漂泊慘遭愛情事業雙重打擊的社畜鄭達前(喬欣飾)，否極泰來得到東北老家拆遷款，踏上了返鄉之行。火流星引發的磁暴，火車在曠野中滯留。目睹了火流星的鄭達前沒想到時空就此發生錯亂，她來到了平行時空！
在這她見到了死去的父親，未曾離婚遠走的母親，兒時的玩伴、錯過的初戀慕子李(馬思超飾)！無法返回原世界的鄭達前，抓住這次機會，將以前的遺憾一一彌補，而她與慕子李過去的一段朦朧戀情，真愛的種子也隨春的到來萌發了。可惜火流星再度出现，鄭達前和慕子李即將成為被分割兩個世界觸不到的戀人……！

programme.title: 流行都市 / Big City Shop 2026 Episode 141
programme.desc: 《流行都市》为观众介绍时令产品、健康养生、健体运动、护肤化妆、时尚服饰、婴幼儿护理、育儿知识、城中美食、饲养宠物等潮流信息，内容包罗万有！主持们亲身体验、示范或测试之外，还会邀请嘉宾带来相关专业知识。烹饪环节方面，多位手势了得的厨艺专家轮流登场，示范简单美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解决煮食烦恼。

programme.title: 快乐长门人 / Happy Old Buddies Episode 77
programme.desc: 不少人或会认为长者并没有性需要，但有调查发现结果却非如此，长者只是因为不同原因引致性生活有所减少。社署临床心理学家林晧明详述世卫对性的定义，并替想跟老伴重启性生活的老友记带来建议。不过，另一半如不想恢复性行为，双方应如何沟通？

programme.title: 港生活．港享受 / Dolce Vita 2021 Episode 50
programme.desc: 香港人生活多姿多采，《港生活．港享受》既呈献高贵典雅的品味生活，也会带来贴地亲民的优质享受。节目结合多元化主题，每集探索不同范畴，并请来各行各业的精英分享成功之道。

programme.title: 再创世纪 / Another Era Episode 2
programme.desc: 第二集 天生遊說英資富商萬學禮合作，更打算套取學禮資金吞併天蔭。定垚獲得倫敦舞團錄取，發現是父親暗中鋪路。松蔭要程凱等人先籌到一百萬資金才注資。定垚考入布拉格舞團卻被阻止，經方澤雨勸說啟堂終讓女兒放手一搏。雷曼破產引發金融海嘯，孝聰趁松蔭中風入院，調用天蔭資金止損，卻更加深陷賀天生陷阱。購買迷你債券的深水埗街坊損失慘重，程凱帶眾人去銀行追討。

programme.desc:
全新儿童节目《Hands Up》鼓励小朋友勇于发问，表达自我，向目标进发！
吉祥物「酱汁家族」成员跟一众主持演出短剧，陪伴大家度过愉快时光。另会带来多首儿歌，让孩子们边唱边学习生活知识。
小朋友走进录像厂，寓学习于娱乐。透过不同主题游戏，加强逻辑思维、锻练体能；玩转STEAM实验，脑力全开！

programme.title: 自然系女子旅行 / The Joy Of Nature Episode 11
programme.desc: 第11集 太空舱露营车智能化体验 映晖的新拍档是「音乐系女神」黄上晏，迎新豪华露营选址桃园。露营车外形仿如太空舱，车厢备有浴缸可供浸浴，更有一系列智能化设备！二人享用过丰盛迎宾下午茶，随即跑到营地游乐场玩旋转木马、咖啡杯，晕到不行！接着换上全副装备在迷你赛车场上争胜，映晖难逃输家宿命，再次肩负晚餐烧烤美食重任，却投诉遭「情绪勒索」？二人在浴缸齐齐泡澡，一睡到天明。翌晨尝过台式早餐，便往体验VR高尔夫球，二人均为初哥，映晖可有胜算？

programme.desc: 第十七集：汪瑶跳楼风波后被方惟安接回家，唐盈盈认为她需心理干预。汪瑶设计诬告方惟安强奸，后又撤诉。唐盈盈录下她承认报复的证据，决定起诉汪瑶。方惟安仍替汪瑶求情，唐盈盈播放录音，令他终于看清真相，也使两人关系走向破裂。

programme.title: 江湖见 / Journey to Jianghu (SR.2) Episode 13
programme.desc: 常言道「读万卷书不如行万里路」。黎耀祥、麦长青再次踏上旅程，继续访寻金庸先生笔下的锦绣山河，探索华夏历史中的江湖世界。他们沿长江与黄河流域游历，穿梭四川、浙江、河南、山西等地，登峨眉金顶、游白帝城、访朱仙镇岳飞庙、探嵩山少林寺，既感受历史古迹的厚重，也品尝当地特色美食。江湖不仅是刀光剑影的舞台，更是人情交错的场域。他们在旅程中亦相约米雪、陈浩民、樊少皇、吕颂贤再度聚首，忆述昔日合作点滴，笑谈往事。

programme.title: 港生活．港享受 / Dolce Vita 2021 Episode 51
programme.desc: 香港人生活多姿多采，《港生活．港享受》既呈献高贵典雅的品味生活，也会带来贴地亲民的优质享受。节目结合多元化主题，每集探索不同范畴，并请来各行各业的精英分享成功之道。

programme.title: 地球大神秘 / Shock Mystery (Sr.2) Episode 2
programme.desc: 人类对未知的事物，与生俱来有种好奇心，甚至有人相信，在生活中的一切事物，并非全部可以单从科学物理现像解释得到，即使表面上有可以接受的答案，也未必能够圆满解释所有疑问！《地球大神秘》制作队从世界各地搜集到数以百计奇异事物内容，都是无法以一般人接受的观点加以解释，除非呢个世界有「超自然」的存在！节目将会让大家知道不可思议的神秘事物，不但在过去存在，而且目前仍然存在！

programme.title: 兄弟帮 / Big Boys Club Episode 379
programme.desc: 《兄弟帮》是由一班「好兄弟」林盛斌、梁竞徽、王梓轩、范振锋及陈国峰主持的年青人清谈节目，每集邀请歌手、艺人或不同界别人士作嘉宾，进行轻松访谈，带来时下社会热话、流行文化、潮流玩意等多元化内容。有关爱情、两性，以致同性关系，是男男女女谈之不尽的话题，节目邀来不同界别的嘉宾「谈情说爱」，探讨两性相处之道。「异度空间」专题，请来嘉宾分享不思议事件，如见鬼、UFO、奇人奇事等刺激话题。

programme.title: 在你的冬夜裡闪耀 / Winter Night Episode 5
programme.desc:
在城市漂泊慘遭愛情事業雙重打擊的社畜鄭達前(喬欣飾)，否極泰來得到東北老家拆遷款，踏上了返鄉之行。火流星引發的磁暴，火車在曠野中滯留。目睹了火流星的鄭達前沒想到時空就此發生錯亂，她來到了平行時空！
在這她見到了死去的父親，未曾離婚遠走的母親，兒時的玩伴、錯過的初戀慕子李(馬思超飾)！無法返回原世界的鄭達前，抓住這次機會，將以前的遺憾一一彌補，而她與慕子李過去的一段朦朧戀情，真愛的種子也隨春的到來萌發了。可惜火流星再度出现，鄭達前和慕子李即將成為被分割兩個世界觸不到的戀人……！

programme.title: 六点半新闻报导& 世界观 & 今日知多D / News At 18:30 & Global View & What's On Today
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报导本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026 Episode 197
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 爱．回家之开心速递 / Lo And Behold Episode 1848
programme.desc: 熊树根(刘丹)由基层做起，他时常牵挂的只有三位宝贝女儿，大女早已移民海外、二女熊若水(吕慧仪)已届适婚年龄却嫁杏无期，经常与优异生妹妹熊心如(苏韵姿)为琐碎事争吵不休，令老爸哭笑不得。

programme.title: 非份之罪 / Deadly Sins Episode 14
programme.desc: 人类的欲望，可驱使我们超越自我，然而，当欲望失控，过份贪图金钱与权势、追求不属于自己的爱，非份之想被无限放大，一不经意，便陷入道德矛盾的深渊，犯下种种「非份之罪」……新界东重案组接连调查几宗案件，包括「无脸女尸」、「石棺禁恋」、「一亿杀机」、「危险游戏」、「肮脏的子弹」、「恐怖情人」，错综复杂的线索、缠绕不清的关系，构成一桩桩匪夷所思的迷案，揭露触摸不透的人性黑暗面。

programme.title: 女神蒙上眼 / The Inner Eye Episode 18
programme.desc: 第十八集：唐盈盈因汪瑶案与戴佩琳意见不合，休假时遇见康俊前妻柏潼。柏潼看出康俊心意，并将摄影侵权案交给唐盈盈。唐盈盈赴四川取证，康俊同行，两人在邛崃山看彩鹮时情感升温。柏潼选择洒脱退出，方惟安也意识到唐盈盈已渐渐离开自己。

programme.title: 娱乐头条 / EXTRA Episode 781
programme.desc: 每晚紧贴香港娱乐圈的消息，以至世界各地的影视娱乐新闻，报导艺人最新动态、剧集和电影宣传、演唱会精华、颁奖礼盛况等，甚至远赴外地采访娱乐盛事、追踪各地影星，专访观众熟悉的歌、影、视红人，让大家瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈的动态和最新消息。

programme.desc: 报导香港、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向

programme.title: 再创世纪 / Another Era Episode 2
programme.desc: 第二集 天生遊說英資富商萬學禮合作，更打算套取學禮資金吞併天蔭。定垚獲得倫敦舞團錄取，發現是父親暗中鋪路。松蔭要程凱等人先籌到一百萬資金才注資。定垚考入布拉格舞團卻被阻止，經方澤雨勸說啟堂終讓女兒放手一搏。雷曼破產引發金融海嘯，孝聰趁松蔭中風入院，調用天蔭資金止損，卻更加深陷賀天生陷阱。購買迷你債券的深水埗街坊損失慘重，程凱帶眾人去銀行追討。

programme.title: 流行都市 / Big City Shop 2026 Episode 142
programme.desc: 《流行都市》为观众介绍时令产品、健康养生、健体运动、护肤化妆、时尚服饰、婴幼儿护理、育儿知识、城中美食、饲养宠物等潮流信息，内容包罗万有！主持们亲身体验、示范或测试之外，还会邀请嘉宾带来相关专业知识。烹饪环节方面，多位手势了得的厨艺专家轮流登场，示范简单美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解决煮食烦恼。

programme.title: 快乐长门人 / Happy Old Buddies Episode 78
programme.desc: 不少人或会认为长者并没有性需要，但有调查发现结果却非如此，长者只是因为不同原因引致性生活有所减少。社署临床心理学家林晧明详述世卫对性的定义，并替想跟老伴重启性生活的老友记带来建议。不过，另一半如不想恢复性行为，双方应如何沟通？

programme.title: 再创世纪 / Another Era Episode 3
programme.desc: 第三集 高哲接受採訪解釋迷你債券，卻被賀天生嘲諷是迷債發明者，高哲指責賀天生是推廣迷債的罪魁禍首，二人話不投機。迷債苦主靜坐時，亦是迷債受害者的思妤父母在現場跳樓自殺。高哲趕到溫哥華安慰思妤，但思妤得知高哲發明迷債憤而分手。天蔭股價大跌，天生與明晞趁低吸納，高哲動用傲堂資金搶貨，並向啟堂直言陳救天蔭等於救香港。高哲卻被街坊認出是迷債黑手，被小慧痛罵。學禮以天生挪用乾坤城資金為由，要求分好處。這時突然傳出，孝聰突然死去的消息。

programme.title: 爱．回家之开心速递 / Lo And Behold Episode 1848
programme.desc: 熊树根(刘丹)由基层做起，他时常牵挂的只有三位宝贝女儿，大女早已移民海外、二女熊若水(吕慧仪)已届适婚年龄却嫁杏无期，经常与优异生妹妹熊心如(苏韵姿)为琐碎事争吵不休，令老爸哭笑不得。

programme.title: Hands Up / Hands Up 2026 Episode 186
programme.desc:
全新儿童节目《Hands Up》鼓励小朋友勇于发问，表达自我，向目标进发！
吉祥物「酱汁家族」成员跟一众主持演出短剧，陪伴大家度过愉快时光。另会带来多首儿歌，让孩子们边唱边学习生活知识。
小朋友走进录像厂，寓学习于娱乐。透过不同主题游戏，加强逻辑思维、锻练体能；玩转STEAM实验，脑力全开！
节目特设表演小舞台，让小朋友展示才艺；齐集创意工作室，DIY小手工。小教「煮」环节，家长和子女共享亲子烹饪乐趣。

programme.title: 教煮争霸 / Clash Of Chefs Episode 14
programme.desc:
第14集 谭俊彦「窝蛋免治牛肉煲仔饭」 VS 陈炜「海鲜肉饼煲仔饭」 砂煲煲仔饭充满传统风味，看过鼎爷传授新砂煲的保养方法，再由俊彦炮制「窝蛋免治牛肉煲仔饭」。俊彦采用上盛免治和牛、牛肩胛肉制作肉饼，配上恰到好处的流心蛋，味道与口感令人期待！
饭焦够香口，看三姐运用普洱茶、花生等制作新派饭焦。炜哥则带来「海鲜肉饼煲仔饭」，除用上瑶柱、虾干等惹味海味，亦自制金银蒜酱衬托海虾，并以带子夹金华火腿，「大堆头」用料令煲仔饭阵容鼎盛，但鼎爷却认为做法浪费了某种食材的鲜味？

programme.title: 非份之罪 / Deadly Sins Episode 14
programme.desc: 人类的欲望，可驱使我们超越自我，然而，当欲望失控，过份贪图金钱与权势、追求不属于自己的爱，非份之想被无限放大，一不经意，便陷入道德矛盾的深渊，犯下种种「非份之罪」……新界东重案组接连调查几宗案件，包括「无脸女尸」、「石棺禁恋」、「一亿杀机」、「危险游戏」、「肮脏的子弹」、「恐怖情人」，错综复杂的线索、缠绕不清的关系，构成一桩桩匪夷所思的迷案，揭露触摸不透的人性黑暗面。

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026 Episode 197
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 兄弟帮 / Big Boys Club Episode 379
programme.desc: 《兄弟帮》是由一班「好兄弟」林盛斌、梁竞徽、王梓轩、范振锋及陈国峰主持的年青人清谈节目，每集邀请歌手、艺人或不同界别人士作嘉宾，进行轻松访谈，带来时下社会热话、流行文化、潮流玩意等多元化内容。有关爱情、两性，以致同性关系，是男男女女谈之不尽的话题，节目邀来不同界别的嘉宾「谈情说爱」，探讨两性相处之道。「异度空间」专题，请来嘉宾分享不思议事件，如见鬼、UFO、奇人奇事等刺激话题。

programme.title: Hands Up / Hands Up 2026 Episode 186
programme.desc:
全新儿童节目《Hands Up》鼓励小朋友勇于发问，表达自我，向目标进发！
吉祥物「酱汁家族」成员跟一众主持演出短剧，陪伴大家度过愉快时光。另会带来多首儿歌，让孩子们边唱边学习生活知识。
小朋友走进录像厂，寓学习于娱乐。透过不同主题游戏，加强逻辑思维、锻练体能；玩转STEAM实验，脑力全开！
节目特设表演小舞台，让小朋友展示才艺；齐集创意工作室，DIY小手工。小教「煮」环节，家长和子女共享亲子烹饪乐趣。

programme.title: 流行都市 / Big City Shop 2026 Episode 143
programme.desc: 《流行都市》为观众介绍时令产品、健康养生、健体运动、护肤化妆、时尚服饰、婴幼儿护理、育儿知识、城中美食、饲养宠物等潮流信息，内容包罗万有！主持们亲身体验、示范或测试之外，还会邀请嘉宾带来相关专业知识。烹饪环节方面，多位手势了得的厨艺专家轮流登场，示范简单美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解决煮食烦恼。

programme.title: 爱．回家之开心速递 / Lo And Behold Episode 1848
programme.desc: 熊树根(刘丹)由基层做起，他时常牵挂的只有三位宝贝女儿，大女早已移民海外、二女熊若水(吕慧仪)已届适婚年龄却嫁杏无期，经常与优异生妹妹熊心如(苏韵姿)为琐碎事争吵不休，令老爸哭笑不得。

programme.title: 女神蒙上眼 & 今日知多D / The Inner Eye & What's On Today Episode 18
programme.desc: 第十八集：唐盈盈因汪瑶案与戴佩琳意见不合，休假时遇见康俊前妻柏潼。柏潼看出康俊心意，并将摄影侵权案交给唐盈盈。唐盈盈赴四川取证，康俊同行，两人在邛崃山看彩鹮时情感升温。柏潼选择洒脱退出，方惟安也意识到唐盈盈已渐渐离开自己。

programme.title: 江湖见 / Journey to Jianghu (SR.2) Episode 14
programme.desc: 常言道「读万卷书不如行万里路」。黎耀祥、麦长青再次踏上旅程，继续访寻金庸先生笔下的锦绣山河，探索华夏历史中的江湖世界。他们沿长江与黄河流域游历，穿梭四川、浙江、河南、山西等地，登峨眉金顶、游白帝城、访朱仙镇岳飞庙、探嵩山少林寺，既感受历史古迹的厚重，也品尝当地特色美食。江湖不仅是刀光剑影的舞台，更是人情交错的场域。他们在旅程中亦相约米雪、陈浩民、樊少皇、吕颂贤再度聚首，忆述昔日合作点滴，笑谈往事。

programme.title: 美食新闻报道 / Gourmet Express Episode 158
programme.desc: 香港汇聚环球美食，特色佳肴、贴地料理受到识饮识食之人的密切关注！黄婉曼、蔡雪莹、倪嘉雯、黄嘉雯、廖慧仪、伍倩彤等美食主播、主持，紧贴最新饮食情报与优惠，深入了解滋味背后的故事。从不同平台网罗超人气食店的情报，主持亲自出动排队、试食，带来真实食评。不设堂食的外卖小店亦深受追捧，有何必吃之选？经营食店难免尝尽甜酸苦辣，摄制队追踪主理人忙碌的一天，从搜购食材、准备材料到开档做生意，揭开「故事味缘」。

programme.title: 最强生命线 / Vital Lifeline Episode 298
programme.desc: 都市人生活节奏紧张，压力又大，身体易出毛病，《最强生命线》为你解构健康之道。首先一连四集介绍都市痛症系列，分别是头痛，肩颈痛，背痛，关节痛。每集都会邀请医学专家讲解各种疾病的成因，还有物理治疗师，运动治疗师教做适当的运动。现在流行中西医结合，美国游泳健将菲比斯都用拔罐来纾缓疼痛，所以每集都会有中医断症，辅以针灸，拔罐和三伏天最适合做的天灸等治疗方法，另外，中医还教我们煲滋补的汤水，都可以调理身体。

programme.title: 兄弟帮 / Big Boys Club Episode 380
programme.desc: 《兄弟帮》是由一班「好兄弟」林盛斌、梁竞徽、王梓轩、范振锋及陈国峰主持的年青人清谈节目，每集邀请歌手、艺人或不同界别人士作嘉宾，进行轻松访谈，带来时下社会热话、流行文化、潮流玩意等多元化内容。有关爱情、两性，以致同性关系，是男男女女谈之不尽的话题，节目邀来不同界别的嘉宾「谈情说爱」，探讨两性相处之道。「异度空间」专题，请来嘉宾分享不思议事件，如见鬼、UFO、奇人奇事等刺激话题。

programme.title: 在你的冬夜裡闪耀 / Winter Night Episode 6
programme.desc:
在城市漂泊慘遭愛情事業雙重打擊的社畜鄭達前(喬欣飾)，否極泰來得到東北老家拆遷款，踏上了返鄉之行。火流星引發的磁暴，火車在曠野中滯留。目睹了火流星的鄭達前沒想到時空就此發生錯亂，她來到了平行時空！
在這她見到了死去的父親，未曾離婚遠走的母親，兒時的玩伴、錯過的初戀慕子李(馬思超飾)！無法返回原世界的鄭達前，抓住這次機會，將以前的遺憾一一彌補，而她與慕子李過去的一段朦朧戀情，真愛的種子也隨春的到來萌發了。可惜火流星再度出现，鄭達前和慕子李即將成為被分割兩個世界觸不到的戀人……！

programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报导本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 再创世纪 / Another Era Episode 3
programme.desc: 第三集 高哲接受採訪解釋迷你債券，卻被賀天生嘲諷是迷債發明者，高哲指責賀天生是推廣迷債的罪魁禍首，二人話不投機。迷債苦主靜坐時，亦是迷債受害者的思妤父母在現場跳樓自殺。高哲趕到溫哥華安慰思妤，但思妤得知高哲發明迷債憤而分手。天蔭股價大跌，天生與明晞趁低吸納，高哲動用傲堂資金搶貨，並向啟堂直言陳救天蔭等於救香港。高哲卻被街坊認出是迷債黑手，被小慧痛罵。學禮以天生挪用乾坤城資金為由，要求分好處。這時突然傳出，孝聰突然死去的消息。

programme.title: 快乐长门人 / Happy Old Buddies Episode 79
programme.desc: 不少人或会认为长者并没有性需要，但有调查发现结果却非如此，长者只是因为不同原因引致性生活有所减少。社署临床心理学家林晧明详述世卫对性的定义，并替想跟老伴重启性生活的老友记带来建议。不过，另一半如不想恢复性行为，双方应如何沟通？

programme.title: 美食新闻报道 / Gourmet Express Episode 158
programme.desc: 香港汇聚环球美食，特色佳肴、贴地料理受到识饮识食之人的密切关注！黄婉曼、蔡雪莹、倪嘉雯、黄嘉雯、廖慧仪、伍倩彤等美食主播、主持，紧贴最新饮食情报与优惠，深入了解滋味背后的故事。从不同平台网罗超人气食店的情报，主持亲自出动排队、试食，带来真实食评。不设堂食的外卖小店亦深受追捧，有何必吃之选？经营食店难免尝尽甜酸苦辣，摄制队追踪主理人忙碌的一天，从搜购食材、准备材料到开档做生意，揭开「故事味缘」。

全新儿童节目《Hands Up》鼓励小朋友勇于发问，表达自我，向目标进发！
吉祥物「酱汁家族」成员跟一众主持演出短剧，陪伴大家度过愉快时光。另会带来多首儿歌，让孩子们边唱边学习生活知识。
小朋友走进录像厂，寓学习于娱乐。透过不同主题游戏，加强逻辑思维、锻练体能；玩转STEAM实验，脑力全开！
节目特设表演小舞台，让小朋友展示才艺；齐集创意工作室，DIY小手工。小教「煮」环节，家长和子女共享亲子烹饪乐趣。
